entries.en: He fully relied on Jehovah , saying : " Our eyes are toward you . " - 2 Chron .
entries.dua: A se ̱ medi nde o mususu mwe ̱ se ̱ na Yehova , a kwala ná : " Miso ̱ masu ma mombwa nde wa . " - 2 Myan .

entries.en: He further showed unselfish love by blessing his children on earth with the prospect of living forever in the Paradise that he had prepared for them .
entries.dua: A bati pe ̱ lee ̱ le ̱ ndolo ni mawase ̱ bwam ba bane ̱ ná a namse ̱ bana bao be o wase , a bola babo ̱ epolo o be ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ la bwindea o paradisi a boṅsane ̱ no ̱ ońol 'abu .

entries.en: He gave a parable in which cultivators mistreated those whom the owner sent to them , just as the Israelites mistreated the prophets whom God sent to them .
entries.dua: A boli munia ma baboledi bena ba tuse ̱ nu ńena sango a mōnda a lomedino ̱ babo ̱ , ka nje te ̱ Bonaisrael ba tuse ̱ no ̱ bato ̱ pedi ba mudī Loba a lomedino ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: He gave me a warm and hearty welcome .
entries.dua: A ta muńe ̱ nge ̱ jita o je ̱ ne ̱ mba , a kasa mba na muyao .

entries.en: He gave the first human couple everything that they needed to be happy - including true freedom .
entries.dua: A boli mome na mut 'a boso nje ye ̱ se ̱ e ta e pula babo ̱ ná ba be ̱ bonam , ba be ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ wonja ńa mbale ̱ .

entries.en: He gave them reasons for carrying out the preaching work .
entries.dua: A boli babo ̱ njo ̱ m ońola nje bangame ̱ nno ̱ benga te ̱ dikalo .

entries.en: He gave us power to carry out our plans , enabling us to work toward proper goals .
entries.dua: ( Min . 2 : 11 ) A boli biso ̱ ngudi o tongwe ̱ le ̱ myano masu , nika e mongwane ̱ ná di we ̱ le ̱ bola o bupe ̱ mambo ma bwam .

entries.en: He gave us thinking ability to solve problems and plan for the future .
entries.dua: A boli biso ̱ dibie ̱ o buka mitakisan na o weka myano ońola kie ̱ le ̱ ni maye ̱ .

entries.en: He generously gave Adam and Eve a variety of precious gifts that enabled them to enjoy life .
entries.dua: 1 : 28 ; Mye . 37 : 29 ) A tele ̱ mulema mao , a bola Adam na Eva ńai na ńai a mabea ma tiki mena ma ta mabola babo ̱ epolo o bwane ̱ longe ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He gives us his love .
entries.dua: A mabola biso ̱ ndol 'ao .

entries.en: He gives us the answer in the very psalm in which he four times asked : " How long ? "
entries.dua: A mabola biso ̱ jalabe ̱ o mwenge a baise ̱ no ̱ myuedi ngedi ine ̱ i ná : " Njik 'etum e ? "

entries.en: He gives us wisdom and strength so that we can cope with any troubles we may face . - Jas .
entries.dua: 34 : 19 ; Yes . 57 : 15 ) A mabola biso ̱ dibie ̱ na ngudi o lembe ̱ to ̱ njika mitakisan di be ̱ nno ̱ . - Yak .

entries.en: He gladly gave up his ill - gotten riches and abandoned his greed for material things .
entries.dua: A ta muńe ̱ nge ̱ o jese ̱ le ̱ m 'bwaṅ mao mu wu na mińakisan , ese ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ ebe ̱ yed 'ao ya mukubo .

entries.en: He got baptized without delay . - Read Acts 22 : 12 - 16 .
entries.dua: Nde dutea ná , dibokime ̱ ne ̱ a so ̱ ṅtane ̱ no ̱ mbale ̱ jombwea epolo Yesu a be ̱ nno ̱ o belondisedi ba mwano ma Loba , Paulo a dubisabe ̱ esibe ̱ jindea . - Langa Bebolo 22 : 12 - 16 .

entries.en: He greeted some who are essentially unknown today - " my beloved Epaenetus " as well as " Tryphaena and Tryphosa , women who are working hard in the Lord . "
entries.dua: A som bō ̱ bena ba si biane ̱ we ̱ nge ̱ - " Eto ̱ nd 'am Epe ̱ neto " nikame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na " Trife ̱ na na Trifosa , [ bito ] ba mano ̱ nge ̱ ndutu o ebol 'a Sango . "

entries.en: He grew up in Alaotra Mangoro , a fertile region in eastern Madagascar .
entries.dua: A kokedi nde o Alaotra Mangoro , o jedu la Madagaskar , we ̱ ni mbota i mapumeano ̱ jita .

entries.en: He guarantees that we will receive blessings when we give in support of the Kingdom .
entries.dua: A mabola biso ̱ mbaki ná di me ̱ nde ̱ kusa minam ke ̱ di boli mabea o sue ̱ le ̱ Janea . ( Mal .

entries.en: He had become a spiritual mentor to me .
entries.dua: A timba sango am ńa mudī .

entries.en: He had been an Austrian politician .
entries.dua: A ta nde mot 'a politik ńa mundi ma Ostria .

entries.en: He had been sentenced to 25 years of hard labor .
entries.dua: A kusi mbako a 25 ma mbu ma ebol 'a ntū .

entries.en: He had clearly in mind his hope of living in the new world under the Messiah 's rule .
entries.dua: A ta a be ̱ ne ̱ dipita di bam la be ̱ longe ̱ o was 'a peńa owas 'a byanedi ba Mesia . ( Bbot .

entries.en: He had come to bring spiritual , not material , benefits to the nation .
entries.dua: A si po ̱ i o londe ̱ ńo ̱ ng 'abu ń 'eyobo nde ńa mudī .

entries.en: He had developed a wrong viewpoint and had become greatly troubled , but he was able to correct his thinking when he entered God 's place of worship .
entries.dua: A ta a be ̱ ne ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ la mambo le mpenga na mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ma pungwea mo ̱ , nde a we ̱ li te ̱ se ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ lao ponda ingedino ̱ o wum 'a jowe ̱ la Loba . ( Mye .

entries.en: He had endured dreadful experiences in Nazi concentration camps .
entries.dua: Nu lembe ̱ mitakisan minde ̱ ne ̱ o ndabo a beboa ńa Nasi .

entries.en: He had faith in the promise made to Abraham and devoted himself to caring for the family who would play a special role in the outworking of Jehovah 's purpose .
entries.dua: A ta a dube ̱ dikaki di bolabe ̱ Abraham , a walame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ o bongwa mbia mwena mu wusa be ̱ ne ̱ epol 'a tobotobo o belondisedi ba mwano ma Yehova . ( Bbot .

entries.en: He had just one wife , even though polygamy began to be practiced soon after the rebellion in Eden . - Gen .
entries.dua: A ta nde a be ̱ ne ̱ muto mō ̱ , to ̱ ná maba ma bań ma botedino ̱ o yamba ombusa pamo o mōnda ma Ede ̱ n . - Bbot .

entries.en: He had just urged Christians to ' make straight paths for their feet . '
entries.dua: A ta nde ome ̱ le ̱ Kriste ̱ n ná i ' po ̱ ngeye myende mabu mangea ma te ̱ m na sim . '

entries.en: He had many desirable qualities .
entries.dua: A ta a be ̱ ne ̱ bede ̱ mo ba bwam jita .

entries.en: He had never built an ark before .
entries.dua: A si ta a málonga elimbi to ̱ buńa .

entries.en: He had noticed a lack of unity or harmony among the apostles , such as during his final meal with them . As had happened before , a dispute arose over " which one of them was considered to be the greatest . "
entries.dua: K 'eyembilan , o da lao disukan na babo ̱ bo bulu , ka ko ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ , musunga mu ta oteten abu o bia " nja ńabu nu malangabe ̱ nunde ̱ ne ̱ buka be ̱ se ̱ . "

entries.en: He had served for over 50 years as a prophet , and then he " became ill with the sickness from which he eventually died . "
entries.dua: A boledi ka muto ̱ ped 'a mudī buka 50 ma mbu , na mo ̱ " a boa diboa lena jalan mo ̱ o kwedi . "

entries.en: He had some firm counsel to give to certain congregations in Asia Minor , but notice how he went about it .
entries.dua: A boli myemba ma Asia nisadi malea ma ngińa ; nde maka o njika mbadi a bolino ̱ nika .

entries.en: He had spent much time with his faithful apostles , and they were united by a special bond .
entries.dua: A tombise ̱ ponda eyeka na bamuloloma bao ba jemea , ba ta pe ̱ ba be ̱ ne ̱ mulatako ma tobotobo .

entries.en: He had strength and physical power that would make any ' macho man ' pale in comparison .
entries.dua: A ta a be ̱ ne ̱ ngudi na ngiń 'a mison bena ba wusa bole ̱ ná to ̱ nja nu mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná e ' mome na mbale ̱ , ' e ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ to ̱ lambo .

entries.en: He had to leave the matter in Jehovah 's hands .
entries.dua: 8 : 1 - 3 ) A bake ̱ so ̱ nde me ̱ se ̱ o mā ma Yehova .

entries.en: He had to put up with his fleshly - minded brother , Esau , who intended to kill him .
entries.dua: A ta angame ̱ n o we ̱ lisane ̱ munańango Esau nu ta nu be ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ m 'eyobo , na nu puli o bwe ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: He had to take time to allow the Bible 's message to touch his heart .
entries.dua: A ta angame ̱ n jese ̱ le ̱ ná mwe ̱ ndi ma Bibe ̱ l mu tape mulema mao .

entries.en: He had to trust that when he truly repented , Jehovah would forgive him and help him endure the consequences of his actions .
entries.dua: 12 : 10 - 12 , 14 ) A ta so ̱ angame ̱ ne ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ dube ̱ na lakisane ̱ ná ate ̱ le ̱ te ̱ na mbale ̱ , Yehova a me ̱ nde ̱ lakise ̱ mo ̱ , ongwane ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ o lembe ̱ betune ba beboledi bao .

entries.en: He has always done that .
entries.dua: Ye nde nje a ko ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: He has been slow to anger and has been just in dealing with Satan 's revolt .
entries.dua: A lee ̱ le ̱ muńo ̱ ngo ̱ o malinga , na te ̱ me ̱ la sim jombwea pamo a Satan .

entries.en: He has provided both the Holy Scriptures and the holy spirit that supports his people .
entries.dua: A boli Betiledi ba Bosangi , name ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na mudī - musangi o bwam ba sue ̱ le ̱ tumba lao .

entries.en: He has set the supreme example of being willing to wait .
entries.dua: A lee ̱ le ̱ mpete ̱ m 'eyembilan a we ̱ lisane ̱ .

entries.en: He has studied human behavior since man was created .
entries.dua: Oko o bia mot 'a benama botea na ponda a wekabe ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: He has sustained me through family difficulties , religious opposition , personal disappointments , and depression .
entries.dua: 94 : 19 ) A sue ̱ le ̱ mba o mitakisan ma mbia , o mabandan ma bebasi , mitakisan mi wu na mbame ̱ ne ̱ , na diboa la mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: He hates " haughty eyes . "
entries.dua: A singe ̱ " byombwedi ba kumba . "

entries.en: He himself says : " I , Jehovah , am your God , the One teaching you to benefit yourself , the One guiding you in the way you should walk . "
entries.dua: Mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ a makwala ná : " Mba nde ne Yehova Loba lo ̱ ngo ̱ , nu malee ̱ wa nje ye ońola bwam bo ̱ ngo ̱ , na ńena nu madie ̱ le ̱ wa o ngea ńena o do ̱ lino ̱ dangwa . "

entries.en: He humbly apologized face - to - face to the brother he had hurt .
entries.dua: A baise ̱ nu munasango milakisan na sibise ̱ la ńolo .

entries.en: He immediately sought spiritual help , but he no longer qualified to be a pioneer or a ministerial servant .
entries.dua: Dibokime ̱ ne ̱ na mo ̱ a kusa jongwane ̱ la mudī , nde a si ta pe ̱ a dongame ̱ n o bolea ka paonia to ̱ so ̱ muboledi o mwemba .

entries.en: He implored God in prayer to help individual Jews to accept the Kingdom message .
entries.dua: A so ̱ so ̱ medi Loba o muka ná ongwane ̱ mot 'a Bonayuda te ̱ ná a kase mwe ̱ ndi ma Janea .

entries.en: He inspired Paul to write : " I . . . appeal to you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called , with all humility and mildness , with patience , putting up with one another in love , earnestly endeavoring to maintain the oneness of the spirit in the uniting bond of peace . "
entries.dua: Yehova a tute ̱ le ̱ Paulo o tila ná : " Na mome ̱ le ̱ so ̱ bińo ̱ . . . , ná lo dangwe kana yangame ̱ nno ̱ bupane ̱ belabe ̱ lena lo belabe ̱ no ̱ , na sibise ̱ la ńolo le ̱ se ̱ na pī na we ̱ lisane ̱ , lo we ̱ lisane ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ o ndolo , lembe ̱ o be ̱ moto mō ̱ ońola jatingane ̱ la musango . " ( Efe .

entries.en: He instructed them : " Render to all their dues : to the one who calls for the tax , the tax ; . . . to the one who calls for honor , such honor . " - Rom .
entries.dua: Anedi Kriste ̱ n ná : " Bola so ̱ moto te ̱ nje angame ̱ nno ̱ kusa : musangise ̱ tax tax ; . . . nu ńangame ̱ n edube edube . " - Rom .

entries.en: He invited us to attend a Bible study in a nearby village .
entries.dua: 3 : 1 - 5 ) Na mo ̱ e bele ̱ biso ̱ o jokwa la Bibe ̱ l o mundi mu ta biso ̱ mbasan .

entries.en: He is " merciful and compassionate , slow to anger and abundant in loyal love and truth . "
entries.dua: E " Muyao na ndolo , muńo ̱ ngo ̱ o malinga , m 'bwaṅ o ndedi na mbale ̱ . " ( Bbu .

entries.en: He is " waiting patiently " and " keeping in expectation " of the time when his name will be fully sanctified .
entries.dua: A " menge ̱ le ̱ " a " pite ̱ " pe ̱ ponda ńena dina lao di me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ sangisabe ̱ ńai ni londi mbom .

entries.en: He is also concerned that we do not stumble others or disturb them by our decisions .
entries.dua: 2 : 9 , 10 ) A si mapula ná di be ̱ bane ̱ eso ̱ njisan to ̱ takise ̱ babo ̱ ońola mpo ̱ so ̱ ko masu .

entries.en: He is forced to wait , and he is not looking forward to the outcome .
entries.dua: E nde eto ̱ m o jenge ̱ le ̱ , a si menge ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ bo buńa na muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He is its Source .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ nde e Tongo ao .

entries.en: He is not , though , the only one promised to be resurrected to heaven as a spirit creature .
entries.dua: ( Bebolo 26 : 23 ) Nde seto ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ nde a kusi kakane ̱ la bepumbwedi omo ̱ ń k 'eweked 'a mudī .

entries.en: He is our Father , God , and Friend ! - Ps .
entries.dua: E nde biso ̱ Tete ̱ , Loba , na Diko ̱ m ! - Mye .

entries.en: He joyfully looked forward to deliverance , and he reflected on how Jehovah had dealt rewardingly with him .
entries.dua: A ta enge ̱ le ̱ jongise ̱ na muńe ̱ nge ̱ , a dutea pe ̱ ne ̱ ni Yehova a namse ̱ no ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: He just glared at me and said , " It 's locked . "
entries.dua: Ombo nde mba ná joṅjoṅ nde alabe ̱ ná " e kwesame ̱ . "

entries.en: He just let me go and never called me in again . "
entries.dua: Ese ̱ le ̱ mba nala nde ba si bele ̱ pe ̱ mba to ̱ buńa . "

entries.en: He kept leaning on " the God of all comfort , who comforts us in all our trials . "
entries.dua: A bengi nde o se ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ na " Loba la lo ̱ ko ̱ mea le ̱ se ̱ , nu malo ̱ ko ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ biso ̱ o ndut 'asu ye ̱ se ̱ . " ( 2 Kor .

entries.en: He kept training himself .
entries.dua: A ta a benga longa mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: He kept training himself and relied on Jehovah 's spirit .
entries.dua: A bengi longa mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ , a se ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ omo ̱ ń a mudī ma Yehova .

entries.en: He kept walking with God .
entries.dua: A tiki nde dangwa na Loba .

entries.en: He knew firsthand how much the holy spirit , the angels , and God 's Word helped him to take the lead when he was on earth .
entries.dua: 28 : 20 ) Mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ e ̱ n na miso ̱ ne ̱ ni mudī - musangi , ange ̱ l , n 'Eyal 'a Loba bongwane ̱ no ̱ mo ̱ o die ̱ le ̱ ke ̱ e o wase .

entries.en: He knew of the Jews ' disdain for Jesus and their determination to expel from the synagogue any who confessed faith in him .
entries.dua: A ta a bia ná Bonayuda ba ta ba singe ̱ Yesu , na ná ba ta ba no ̱ ngo ̱ bedomsedi ná to ̱ nja nu me ̱ nde ̱ dube ̱ mo ̱ a mabusisabe ̱ o ndabo a ndongame ̱ n .

entries.en: He knew that , among other things , God wanted him " to declare good news to the poor . . . and a recovery of sight to the blind . "
entries.dua: A ta a bia ná , omo ̱ ń a me ̱ se ̱ , Loba a ta a pula ná a ' langweye batuedi myango ma bwam . . . bandima pe ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ . '

entries.en: He knew that false worship , including devotion to material riches , would be a denial of " the true God above . "
entries.dua: A ta a bia ná jowe ̱ di kwedi , na to ̱ ndo ̱ la bema , be nde to ̱ bo ̱ la " Loba la mo ̱ ń . "

entries.en: He knew that his daily custom was well - known .
entries.dua: A ta a bia ná ko ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ lao di ta di biane ̱ na be ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: He knew that his earthly ministry would come to an end and that others would carry on his work .
entries.dua: A ta a bia ná ebol 'ao ya dikalo o wase e me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ o su , bape ̱ pe ̱ balane ̱ mo ̱ oboso .

entries.en: He knew that Jehovah would eventually bring an end to that wicked world .
entries.dua: 6 : 4 , 9 - 13 ) A ta a bia ná ye ̱ ke ̱ i te ̱ Yehova a me ̱ nde ̱ ńamse ̱ ni was 'a bobe buńa bō ̱ .

entries.en: He knows this and has lovingly made provision for us by means of Christ 's ransom .
entries.dua: A bi nika , ońola nika nde a wekedino ̱ biso ̱ mwano ma ndolo mwe nde diko ̱ ti la Kristo .

entries.en: He labeled such behavior as that of " the sons of this system of things , " but he used the illustration to drive home a point .
entries.dua: Nika ńe nde mo ̱ mbad 'a bola ńa " bana ba nin wase ; " a bolane ̱ nde mun munia o jokwe ̱ le ̱ belēdi ba mweńa .

entries.en: He later " came to have seven more sons and three more daughters . "
entries.dua: Na ponda " a yai pe ̱ te ̱ bana ba bome samba na ba bito balalo . "

entries.en: He later stated : " This is not man 's work . "
entries.dua: O sukan a kwala ná : " Yen ebolo e titi ya mot 'a benama . "

entries.en: He later wrote : " To me , a man less than the least of all holy ones , this undeserved kindness was given , so that I should declare to the nations the good news about the unfathomable riches of the Christ . "
entries.dua: ( 1 Kor . 15 : 9 ) Ombusa ponda a bata ná : " Mba ńena ńe bosadi buka basangedi be ̱ se ̱ nde nin ndedi e bweabe ̱ le ̱ no ̱ , o langwea basibi m 'bwaṅ ma Kristo mwena mu si mawe ̱ le ̱ wasabe ̱ . " ( Efe .

entries.en: He learned some expressions in their language and thought about the many Antandroy people who had not yet been reached with the Kingdom message .
entries.dua: Oko byala bō ̱ ba eyem 'abu , na mo ̱ o ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ jita la bato ba Antandroy bena ba si bedi senge ̱ myango ma bwam .

entries.en: He left about one o 'clock the next morning .
entries.dua: Bone ̱ bao nde alono ̱ , lambo ka nge ̱ ṅ po ̱ .

entries.en: He lets go altogether when the child can keep his balance .
entries.dua: Muyedi ā te ̱ mbaki ná muna a mábia ja bwam na duane ̱ pe ̱ , a mese ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ niponda ná a duane ̱ na mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: He liked to have the first place in the congregation , he received nothing from John with respect , and he was spreading malicious talk about the apostle and others .
entries.dua: A ta a to ̱ ndo ̱ be ̱ ńaboso o mwemba , a si ta a kasa n 'edube nje e ta e wa na Yohane , a to ̱ po ̱ pe ̱ byala ba bobe ońola ńamuloloma na bane ̱ .

entries.en: He lived during the reign of wicked King Ahaz , a time when all sorts of corruption prevailed .
entries.dua: A ta nde longe ̱ pond 'a janea la Kiṅ 'a bobe Ahas , ponda ńai a mate ̱ ki ye ̱ se ̱ i tano ̱ .

entries.en: He lived in that world for almost 600 years !
entries.dua: A jai o ni wase buka 600 ba mbu ! ( Bbot .

entries.en: He lovingly assured them that he would help them to reestablish pure worship , but he also firmly warned them that he would not tolerate halfhearted worship .
entries.dua: A boli babo ̱ mbaki na ndolo ná a me ̱ nde ̱ jongwane ̱ babo ̱ o timbise ̱ le ̱ jowe ̱ la mbale ̱ peńa , nde ome ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ na ngińa ná a si me ̱ nde ̱ kasa jowe ̱ labu yete ̱ na di titi mususu .

entries.en: He made both natural laws and moral laws to ensure that everything functions harmoniously .
entries.dua: A te ̱ se ̱ bete ̱ sedi ońola bewekedi na bete ̱ sedi ońola bedangwedi ná mambo me ̱ se ̱ ma dangwe mulatako na o mbad 'a bwam . ( Mye .

entries.en: He made his way back to Karítsa , where my older brother , Ilias , bombarded him with questions about the Bible .
entries.dua: A timba o Karitsa owe ̱ ni munańango am ńa mome ńa mutudu Ilias a wo ̱ lise ̱ no ̱ mo ̱ na myuedi jombwea Bibe ̱ l .

entries.en: He made sure that police officers stood near our home for a week , and the persecutors gave us no more trouble .
entries.dua: Nu mwanedi a boli ná polisi i tate bolongi bwasu woki po ̱ ńa mususu , na nika nde di si kusino ̱ pe ̱ mitakisan .

entries.en: He made the earth to be man 's everlasting home , a place where man does not just survive but enjoys life to the full .
entries.dua: A weki nde wase ná moto a be ̱ oten po ̱ ko ̱ po ̱ ko ̱ , seto ̱ tet 'a wum 'a boja , nde wuma yena a mabwane ̱ no ̱ longe ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He married an English - speaking sister !
entries.dua: A timbi ba munańango nu mato ̱ pe ̱ Inglisi .

entries.en: He may attempt to convince people that there is a way to live forever without obeying Jehovah .
entries.dua: A me ̱ nde ̱ keka wo ̱ ndo ̱ bato ná be ná ba be ̱ longe ̱ o bwindea esibe ̱ sengane ̱ Yehova .

entries.en: He may guide us by means of holy spirit .
entries.dua: E ná a die ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ tongwea na mudī - musangi .

entries.en: He may have been a court official who was a personal friend and companion to the king , one who at times carried out confidential orders .

entries.en: He sets the example for us by living up to his promises , and he will help us live up to ours .

entries.dua: Di bole so ̱ me ̱ se ̱ o jembilane ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: He showed great courage , went to work , and with Jehovah 's help completed the magnificent temple in seven and a half years .
entries.dua: A lee ̱ le ̱ ngin 'a mulema ninde ̱ ne ̱ , ala bola ebolo , a bo ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ longa ni tempe ̱ l ninde ̱ ne ̱ na jongwane ̱ la Yehova o pambo a ponda ńa mbu samba n 'epasi .

entries.en: He showed great patience in putting up with the weaknesses of his followers .
entries.dua: 11 : 29 ) A lee ̱ le ̱ we ̱ lisane ̱ dinde ̱ ne ̱ na bo ̱ bo ̱ la bokwedi bao .

entries.en: He showed restraint when he was serving in the house of Potiphar , the chief of Pharaoh 's guards .
entries.dua: A lee ̱ le ̱ jalea la ńolo ke ̱ e muboledi o mbo 'a Potifar , mwaned 'a batatedi ba Farao .

entries.en: He showed that such conduct violated the royal law : " You must love your neighbor as yourself . "
entries.dua: A lee ̱ ná yin ńai a beboledi ye nde bula la nin mbenda ninde ̱ ne ̱ : " To ̱ ndo ̱ munaso ̱ ngo ̱ ka wame ̱ ne ̱ . "

entries.en: He simply recognized and accepted his changing circumstances and his limitations .
entries.dua: Embi nde moyo mao emea pe ̱ ná bete ̱ medi bao be mátukwa .

entries.en: He sought refuge in the tent of Jael , the wife of Heber the Kenite , and was welcomed by Jael .
entries.dua: Na mo ̱ ala pulise ̱ diwutamea o muno ̱ ko ̱ ma Yael , munj 'a Hebe ̱ r mot 'a Ken , na Yael inge ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: He spared the life of Agag , an enemy of God 's people , and he also spared the best of the flock .
entries.dua: Nik 'e ta nde si sengane ̱ .

entries.en: He spoke about the matter to an elder , who asked Christoph to think about certain dangers before making a decision , such as the risk of getting infected by the spirit of competition .
entries.dua: A kwalisane ̱ mutudu mō ̱ nika , na nu mutudu a kwalane ̱ mo ̱ ná a se ̱ le ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ mambo ma ńai na ńai nika ńeno ̱ ná e wana , k 'eyembilan , edi a pembisan , denge ̱ a máno ̱ ngo ̱ bedomsedi .

entries.en: He spoke in English , and afterward I gave a summary of his talk in Tagalog .
entries.dua: A tombise ̱ nde mo ̱ na Inglisi , nde ombusa ponda na bola patape ̱ m ń 'ekwal 'ao na bwambo ba Tagalog .

entries.en: He spoke of " Jesus Christ the Nazarene , whom you executed on a stake but whom God raised up from the dead . "
entries.dua: A to ̱ pedi ońola " Yesu Kristo ńa Nasaret , lo bome ̱ le ̱ no ̱ o [ ebongo , NW ] ńena Loba a pumbwe ̱ le ̱ no ̱ o kwedi . "

entries.en: He started off with a greeting .
entries.dua: E botedi nde na masoma .

entries.en: He started to teach them many things .
entries.dua: ' A kumo lee ̱ babo ̱ mambo jita . '

entries.en: He stated : " There is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , foreigner , Scythian , slave , or freeman . "
entries.dua: Mo ̱ ná : " Oten e titi mot 'a Grikia to ̱ mot 'a Bonayuda , bwendi to ̱ ka ni titi bwendi , mwe ̱ n , mot 'a Skite , mukom , wonja . "

entries.en: He stated : " We knew , however , that getting married was not unscriptural , so we took refuge in prayer and put our trust in Jehovah . "
entries.dua: Mo ̱ ná : " Di ta di bia ná , latise ̱ la diba di si mate ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ Betiledi , muka nde mu timbi biso ̱ diwutamea , di lakisane ̱ pe ̱ Yehova . "

entries.en: He stated : " You wives , be in subjection to your husbands , as it is becoming in the Lord .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ ná : " A bito , sibise ̱ bińo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ owas 'a bome bańu , kana yangame ̱ nno ̱ o Sango .

entries.en: He states : " I am grateful for Jehovah 's overwhelming mercy and forgiveness . "
entries.dua: Mo ̱ ná : " Na matimbise ̱ le ̱ Yehova jita la masoma ońola nded 'ao ni pakapakane ̱ na ná a lakise ̱ pe ̱ mba . "

entries.en: He states : " None of these beautiful blessings would be part of my life if I hadn 't accepted Jehovah 's help to give my personality a complete makeover . "
entries.dua: E , mo ̱ ná : " Na si wusa kusa bonam to ̱ bō ̱ ma min me ̱ se ̱ o longe ̱ lam yete ̱ na na banga jongwane ̱ la Yehova o songwa mudun a moto . "

entries.en: He still expects us , however , to use our finances to support the work of his organization today .
entries.dua: Nde a mengane ̱ biso ̱ ná di bolane ̱ mo ̱ ni masu o sue ̱ le ̱ ebol 'a bebokedi bao nin we ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He strongly believed that everyone should be able to benefit from God 's Word .
entries.dua: A ta a dube ̱ ná moto te ̱ angame ̱ n tombwane ̱ Eyal 'a Loba .

entries.en: He takes our vows seriously , and we must fulfill them in order to have his approval .
entries.dua: A mano ̱ ngo ̱ byala basu mweńa , je pe ̱ eto ̱ m o londise ̱ mo ̱ ná a do ̱ lisane ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: He taught me to operate a portable phonograph so that we could play records containing short Bible talks .
entries.dua: Okwe ̱ le ̱ mba o bolane ̱ fonograf ná bato ba senge bekwali ba Bibe ̱ l be wuto .

entries.en: He tells us : " As for me , I will keep on the lookout for Jehovah .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ na biso ̱ ná : " Nde mba na mombwa nde Yehova , dipita lam le nde na Loba la jongise ̱ lam .

entries.en: He then listed 19 negative traits , or qualities , that would characterize people in this time period .
entries.dua: Na mo ̱ a bola 19 la bede ̱ mo bena bato ba me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ o min mińa misukan .

entries.en: He then sent an angel who destroyed 185,000 Assyrians in one night ! - 2 Ki .
entries.dua: ( 2 Ki . 18 : 22 - 25 ; 19 : 6 ) Na mo ̱ a loma so ̱ ange ̱ l ńena ni bo 185 000 la bato ba Asiria bulu bō ̱ ! - 2 Ki .

entries.en: He thinks about the people of Philippi .
entries.dua: E o jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ bato ba Filipi .

entries.en: He thought , felt , and acted like Jehovah and lived in harmony with God 's will and standards .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ mao , besengedi bao , na beboledi bao ba ta bowan na ba Yehova ; a ta pe ̱ nde a die ̱ le ̱ longe ̱ lao kaponda jemea na bete ̱ sedi ba Loba .

entries.en: He thus balances his power of foreknowledge with his respect for our free will .
entries.dua: ( Bbo . 18 : 20 , 21 ; 22 : 12 ) A si mabola ná ngiń 'ao ńa bia oboso ba ponda nje e mapo ̱ e kate moyo ma wonj 'asu ńa bepo ̱ sedi .

entries.en: He thus taught his children well and set a fine example for them , which was a big challenge during that wicked pre - Flood era . - Gen .
entries.dua: Okwe ̱ le ̱ bana bao bwam , a we ̱ pe ̱ o be ̱ eyembilan a bwam ońol 'abu , lambo lena di si ta bu o bola o mi mińa ma bobe mi se ̱ le ̱ na Mpupe . - Bbot .

entries.en: He told Jehovah that he was so happy about his little girl 's decision to dedicate her life to Him . "
entries.dua: A kwalane ̱ Yehova ná e muńe ̱ nge ̱ jita ońola bedomsedi son ao ya mun 'a muto a no ̱ ngino ̱ o bake ̱ mo ̱ Loba longe ̱ lao . "

entries.en: He told my mother that my association with Jehovah 's Witnesses set a bad example for the other students .
entries.dua: A ta a langwea ńango am ná mulatako mam na Mboṅ a Yehova mwe nde eyembilan a bobe ońola bane ̱ bautu .

entries.en: He told Nathan to tell David : " You are not the one who will build the house for me to dwell in . "
entries.dua: Na mo ̱ a langwea Natan ná a bīse ̱ David ná : " Seto ̱ wa nde o malongeye ̱ mba ndabo na majano ̱ . "

entries.en: He told Pilate that his work on earth was to " bear witness to the truth . " - Read John 18 : 37 .
entries.dua: A langwedi Pilato ná ebol 'ao e ta nde ná a " bole mboṅ ońola mbale ̱ . " - Langa Yohane 18 : 37 .

entries.en: He told the congregation in Laodicea : " All those for whom I have affection , I reprove and discipline .
entries.dua: 2 : 1 - 5 , 12 , 13 , 18 , 19 ) A kwalisane ̱ mwemba ma Laodikea ná : " Be ̱ se ̱ bena na to ̱ ndino ̱ na masa babo ̱ na ko ̱ kise ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: He told them : " Let us consider one another so as to incite to love and fine works , not forsaking our meeting together , as some have the custom , but encouraging one another , and all the more so as you see the day drawing near . "
entries.dua: A kwalane ̱ babo ̱ ná : " Jombwane ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ ná jumwe ̱ le ̱ ndolo na bebolo ba bwam ; di s 'ese ̱ le ̱ jako ̱ to ̱ ne ̱ lasu , kana dongo ba mabolano ̱ , nde jomane ̱ le ̱ nde , sepo ̱ n kana lo me ̱ ne ̱ no ̱ ná buńa bo masisea be ̱ be ̱ . "

entries.en: He told them that if he had been in their place , he ' would have strengthened them with the words of his mouth , and the consolation of his lips would have brought them relief . '
entries.dua: A kwalane ̱ babo ̱ ná , a be ̱ te ̱ o epol 'abu a ' wusa jembe ̱ babo ̱ mulema na mudumbu na dipa bepopo bao o lo ̱ ko ̱ babo ̱ . '

entries.en: He told us that Bethel was not accepting married couples at that time .
entries.dua: A langwedi biso ̱ ná o niponda Bete ̱ l e si ta ńemea babaedi .

entries.en: He too came in the truth and served faithfully as an elder in Ottawa , Ontario , up until his death .
entries.dua: ( Bebolo 17 : 10 , 11 ) Mo ̱ pe ̱ a timbi be ̱ munasango , a bolea na jemea ka mutudu o Otawa , Ontario , nate ̱ na o kwed 'ao .

entries.en: He too later served as a member of the Governing Body .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ pe ̱ a boledi ombusa ponda k 'elong 'a Dibe ̱ le ̱ di Madie ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: He too was one of the anointed and had outstanding zeal for the ministry .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ pe ̱ a ta nde mō ̱ ńa bo ̱ kisabe ̱ , nde a be ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ ko ̱ di ninde ̱ ne ̱ ońola ebol 'a dikalo .

entries.en: He took care of his disciples and considered their needs .
entries.dua: Ombwedi ńo ̱ ng 'a bokwedi bao .

entries.en: He took steps to ensure that those delivering the funds cared for " everything honestly , not only in the sight of Jehovah but also in the sight of men . "
entries.dua: A boli me ̱ se ̱ ná a be ̱ mbaki ná ba bena ba mabusise ̱ mo ̱ ni bombweye mambo me ̱ se ̱ " bwam , seto ̱ buka te ̱ oboso ba [ Yehova ] mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ , nde oboso ba bato pe ̱ . "

entries.en: He trained them thoroughly , and they spread the good news throughout the then - known world . - Col .
entries.dua: ( Yohane 14 : 12 ) A longi babo ̱ bwam , ba laṅse ̱ pe ̱ myango ma bwam o wase ńe ̱ se ̱ ńa ni ponda . - Kol .

entries.en: He tried his best to help me emotionally .
entries.dua: A we ̱ na ngud 'ao ńe ̱ se ̱ o jongwane ̱ mba lo ̱ ko ̱ besengedi bam ba teten .

entries.en: He truly cared for people .
entries.dua: A ta ombwea bato na mbale ̱ .

entries.en: He truly knew Jehovah , and he acted on that knowledge .
entries.dua: A ta a bia Yehova na mbale ̱ , beboledi bao pe ̱ be lee ̱ le ̱ nika .

entries.en: He truly proved to be a wise one .
entries.dua: A ta a lee ̱ le ̱ na mbale ̱ ná e nde ńa dibie ̱ mō ̱ .

entries.en: He trusted in Jehovah completely and was prepared to see his assignment through , wherever Jehovah would allow it to take him .
entries.dua: A ta a be ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ Yehova lakisane ̱ di bo ̱ le ̱ , a le ̱ le ̱ me ̱ pe ̱ o londise ̱ m 'bē ̱ mao mbom , to ̱ e be ̱ nde we ̱ ni Yehova a me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ pula ná ale .

entries.en: He understands our situation and loves us .
entries.dua: 16 : 9 ) A bi bete ̱ medi basu , a to ̱ ndi pe ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: He understands the processes involved and has the ability to undo any damage .
entries.dua: A be ̱ n so ̱ ṅtane ̱ la nika na ngudi o po ̱ ngulane ̱ to ̱ njika bobe nde .

entries.en: He understood the pressures they faced as they were surrounded by enemies .
entries.dua: A ta a so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná ba ta o bete ̱ medi ba ngińa kana ba tano ̱ ba dingabe ̱ le ̱ na basingedi .

entries.en: He urged others to serve Jehovah .
entries.dua: A ta a ńakisane ̱ bane ̱ ná ba boleye Yehova .

entries.en: He urged us to use our freedom " as slaves of God . "
entries.dua: Ome ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ o bolane ̱ wonj 'asu " ka bautu ba Loba . "

entries.en: He used an opportunity to do so when a scribe asked : " Who really is my neighbor ? "
entries.dua: A lee ̱ le ̱ nika ponda mubied 'a mbenda mō ̱ a baise ̱ no ̱ mo ̱ ná : " Nja e munasango am e ? "

entries.en: He uses your display of support to make a reply to the taunts of Satan .
entries.dua: 23 : 15 , 16 ) Jemea lasu nde Yehova a mabolane ̱ no ̱ o jalabe ̱ Satan nu mato ̱ po ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ dibena .

entries.en: He usually looked to God for direction .
entries.dua: A ta be ̱ a pulise ̱ bediedi o mbasanedi ma Loba .

entries.en: He values humanity so highly that he was willing to let his only - begotten Son die in our behalf .
entries.dua: 1 : 19 ) Mbel 'a moto ńe mo ̱ tiki kańena ese ̱ le ̱ ná mpo ̱ m mao ma Muna mu wo ̱ ońol 'asu .

entries.en: He viewed marriage as a sacred bond between a man and a woman .
entries.dua: A ta e ̱ ne ̱ diba la mome na muto ka mulatako mwe bosangi .

entries.en: He wanted Adam and Eve and all parents after them to love their children as Jehovah loved his first perfect human children .
entries.dua: Ńo ̱ ng 'ao e ta nde ná Adam na Eva , nikame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na bayedi be ̱ se ̱ bena ba me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ ombus 'abu ba to ̱ nde bana babu ka nje te ̱ Yehova a tano ̱ a to ̱ ndo ̱ bana bao baboso b 'eyobo ba ta ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He wanted to enable students to distinguish between the root of Hebrew words in the Bible and any associated prefixes or suffixes .
entries.dua: A ta nde a pula jongwane ̱ bautu o we ̱ le ̱ diwengisan oteten a mwanga mw 'eyal 'a Bonahebe ̱ r o Bibe ̱ l na byala be bati oboso to ̱ so ̱ o mbusa mwanga mw 'eyal 'a Bonahebe ̱ r .

entries.en: He wants us , not to obsess over the details of the Law , but to discern and apply its " weightier matters , " the lofty principles that underpin its commandments .
entries.dua: A si mapula ná jombweye mambo mao ma sadisadi buka te ̱ , nde ná di so ̱ ṅtane ̱ na we ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ o ebolo ' mambo mao ma mweńa , ' me nde bete ̱ sedi bena be bambe ̱ yi mbenda .

entries.en: He wants us to choose our own course in life .
He wants us to seek material benefits first - to have it all and have it now . Satan urges us to seek the Kingdom second . - Matt .
entries.dua: A mapula ná di se ̱ le ̱ nde pulise ̱ sango ná di be ̱ ne ̱ di longe ̱ tatan ; denge ̱ Janea la Loba . - Mat .

entries.en: He wants you to be happy .
entries.dua: 6 : 20 ) A mapula ná o be ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: He was " setting a pattern for ungodly people of things to come . "
entries.dua: A ta nde " a te ̱ se ̱ mo ̱ k 'eyembilan a nje e me ̱ nde ̱ ko ̱ ye ̱ bato ba bobe . "

entries.en: He was , however , a distant relative of Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and Jehovah had revealed details to them about himself and his purpose for mankind .
entries.dua: A ta nde mbia m 'etum ma Abraham , Isak na Yakob . Yehova a ta a teleye ̱ ban baboledi bao be ̱ se ̱ nja eno ̱ name ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na mwano mao ońola mbel 'a moto .

entries.en: He was 93 years old when he died .
entries.dua: A wedi ke ̱ e 93 ma mbu .

entries.en: He was a brave warrior ; she was a humble homemaker .
entries.dua: A ta nde mot 'a bwemba ńa ngińa , mo ̱ pe ̱ mut 'a makwasi nu sibise ̱ ńolo .

entries.en: He was a false messiah in the first century who misled a large number .
entries.dua: A ta nde Mesia ńa lobango o ńo ̱ ṅo ̱ n a boso nu lo ̱ ndi dimuti dinde ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: He was a personal associate of Jesus and had been entrusted with significant responsibilities .
entries.dua: A dango na Yesu , a bolabe ̱ pe ̱ m 'bē ̱ minde ̱ ne ̱ . ( Mat .

entries.en: He was a tireless worker for the truth and had tremendous appreciation for the missionaries around the world .
entries.dua: A si ta a wo ̱ lo ̱ bola ebolo ońola mbale ̱ , a londa pe ̱ na masoma ońola ebol 'a bamuloloma o wase ńe ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: HE WAS a valiant leader ; she was a submissive wife .
entries.dua: A TA NDE mudied 'a ngiń 'a mulema , mo ̱ pe ̱ muto nu sibise ̱ ńolo .

entries.en: He was a wonderful husband for 55 years , one who loved Jehovah and helped many brothers .
entries.dua: O 55 ma mbu ma diba di tombise ̱ no ̱ , a ta nde mom 'a bwam , nu ta nu to ̱ ndo ̱ Yehova na ńongwane ̱ pe ̱ bonasango jita .

entries.en: He was accompanied by two others , one of whom was Shebna , now serving as secretary .
entries.dua: A ta na baba bape ̱ pe ̱ , mō ̱ ńabu a ta nde Sebna , nu ta nde nu matimbe ̱ mutiledi .

entries.en: He was also " waiting for the Kingdom of God , " which may explain why he became one of Jesus ' disciples .
entries.dua: A ta pe ̱ " enge ̱ le ̱ Janea la Loba , " yen ebe ońola nika nde a timbino ̱ mō ̱ ńa bokwedi ba Yesu .

entries.en: He was also the son who inherited a double portion of property . - Gen .
entries.dua: Mo ̱ pe ̱ nde a ta muna nu ta nu be ̱ ne ̱ bwam na mongo maba ma sango . - Bbot .

entries.en: He was also very spiritually inclined .
entries.dua: A ta pe ̱ a to ̱ ndo ̱ mambo ma mudī .

entries.en: He was an instructor at the Bible School of Gilead , and later he served as a member of the Governing Body .
entries.dua: A ta nde mulēdi o Esukul 'a Bibe ̱ l ya Gilead , ombusa ponda a boledi ka elong 'a Dibe ̱ le ̱ di Madie ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: He was baptized , and today he serves as an elder .
entries.dua: A dubisabe ̱ , we ̱ nge ̱ a mabolea ka mutudu o mwemba .

entries.en: He was baptized in 1914 at 17 years of age .
entries.dua: A dubisabe ̱ o mbu má 1914 o bodun ba 17 la mbu .

entries.en: He was born in a nation that was dedicated to God .
entries.dua: A ta nde a yabe ̱ o tumba di ta di bake ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ na Loba .

entries.en: He was critical of the elders who had been involved in his disfellowshipping .
entries.dua: A ta a sa batudu bena ba bupe ̱ bete ̱ sedi ba Loba ba sumwa nu bangi jate ̱ le ̱ o mwemba .

entries.en: He was determined to make an effort to restore peace .
entries.dua: Na mo ̱ a no ̱ ngo ̱ bedomsedi o koma musango .

entries.en: He was diagnosed with Parkinson 's disease .
entries.dua: Ba ta ba so ̱ mo ̱ diboa la Parkinson .

entries.en: He was driven to the depths of poverty and despair .
entries.dua: A so ̱ lo ̱ o ndenge ̱ na o tue dinde ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: He was fully devoted to Jehovah , for " he continued to keep the commandments that Jehovah had given to Moses . " - 2 Ki .
entries.dua: A ta a tingame ̱ o mususu mwe ̱ se ̱ na Yehova ebanja " a ta a ne ̱ nge ̱ myeka myena Yehova a bolino ̱ Mose . " - 2 Ki .

entries.en: He was genuinely interested in their spiritual welfare , and he willingly expended himself in their behalf .
entries.dua: A ta ombwea ja labu la bwam la mudī , a ta pe ̱ be ̱ be ̱ o bola mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ ońol 'abu .

entries.en: He was keenly aware that he was the victim of many injustices .
entries.dua: A ta a bia bwambwam ná si te ̱ me ̱ la sim di kweledi mo ̱ o matongo me ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: He was moved by " the goodwill of [ his ] heart . "
entries.dua: " Mpuli ma mulema [ mao ] , " nde mu tute ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ o bola nika .

entries.en: He was neither overconfident nor paralyzed with fear .
entries.dua: A si ta pe ̱ to ̱ a lakisane ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ buka moyo , to ̱ soasoane ̱ na bo ̱ ngo ̱ .

entries.en: He was not familiar with the Scriptures .
entries.dua: A si ta so ̱ a bia Eyal 'a Loba .

entries.en: He was not fooled by the materialized demons , who surely impressed faithless , gullible humans with their superhuman abilities - perhaps even to the point of becoming objects of idolatry .
entries.dua: A si lemsabe ̱ na midī ma bobe mi bo ̱ ti mańolo ma bato o po ̱ o wase , mena bato ba pulino ̱ o jowe ̱ ońola ngińa ni buki ńa mot 'a benama ba tano ̱ ba be ̱ ne ̱ . ( Bbot .

entries.en: He was not jealous when David was appointed heir to the throne .
entries.dua: A si ko ̱ no ̱ ne ̱ David ná a po ̱ so ̱ be ̱ o be ̱ Kiṅe ̱ .

entries.en: He was not satisfied with his extensive freedom to carry out his God - given mandate : " Be fruitful and become many , fill the earth and subdue it , and have in subjection the fish . . . , the flying creatures . . . , and every living creature that is moving on the earth . "
entries.dua: A si bwane ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ wonja a batino ̱ kusa o londise ̱ ndaki Loba a bolino ̱ mo ̱ ná : " Bińo ̱ be ̱ yadi , lo to ̱ nde , lo londise ̱ wase , lo sibise ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ owas 'ańu ; lo be ̱ ne ̱ janea omo ̱ ń a su 'a madiba . . . , lono ̱ n la mo ̱ ń . . . , na ńama ye ̱ se ̱ i matuse ̱ ńolo wase . " ( Bbo .

entries.dua: O mbu ma 1966 , na te ̱ se ̱ be ̱ wonja o beboa , nde biso ̱ bane ̱ i jala o mundi ma Armavir , o mbasan ma Munja ma Mundo .

entries.en: In 1966 both north and south Ireland were united under the Dublin branch office - a sharp contrast to the political and religious divisions on the island .
entries.dua: O mbu má 1966 , Ireland ibane ̱ ńa pongo na ńa mikondo i lati owas 'a byombwedi ba mukanjo m 'ebolo ma Dublin - diwengisan dinde ̱ ne ̱ na diwanje ̱ la politik na bebasi le oteten abu o mu mundi .

entries.en: In 1978 , when Maria was 45 , she again became pregnant .
entries.dua: O mbu ma 1978 , Maria a no ̱ ngi pe ̱ te ̱ deme ̱ ke ̱ e 45 ma mbu .

entries.en: In 1979 , Lene and I welcomed the arrival of our fifth child , Daniel .
entries.dua: O mbu má 1979 , biso ̱ na Lene di bo muńe ̱ nge ̱ o be ̱ ne ̱ muna nu londe ̱ batanu , Daniel .

entries.en: In 1987 , our son Yaroslav moved to the city of Riga in Latvia , where he was able to preach more openly .
entries.dua: O mbu ma 1987 , mun 'asu Yaroslav alo o mundi ma Riga o Latvia , we ̱ ni a tano ̱ a te ̱ dikalo na wonja .

entries.en: In 1987 a brother asked me to visit an interested person living in the town of Balykchy .
entries.dua: O 1987 munasango mō ̱ a baise ̱ mba ná na pe ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ moto nu ta nu to ̱ ndo ̱ mbale ̱ o mundi ma Balykchy .

entries.en: In 1990 , our son Pavel , then 19 years old , wanted to pioneer on Sakhalin , an island north of Japan .
entries.dua: O mbu ma 1990 , mun 'asu Pavel pe ̱ a ta a pula be ̱ paonia ke ̱ e 19 la mbu , o Sakhalin , eyondi ewo ̱ ye o pongo a Yapan .

entries.en: In 1991 , the activity of Jehovah 's Witnesses was given legal recognition .
entries.dua: O mbu ma 1991 , ebol 'a Mboṅ a Yehova e ta e te ̱ se ̱ be ̱ wonja .

entries.en: In 1991 my wife and I attended our first - ever convention in Alma - Ata , now known as Almaty , in Kazakhstan .
entries.dua: O mbu 1991 biso ̱ na munj 'am jukedi o jako ̱ to ̱ ne ̱ lasu dinde ̱ ne ̱ laboso o mundi ma Alma - Ata o Kasakstan , mu mabelabe ̱ we ̱ nge ̱ ná Almaty .

entries.en: In 1992 , I was appointed to serve as an elder , the first Kyrgyz elder in the country .
entries.dua: O mbu 1992 , na te ̱ se ̱ be ̱ ka mutudu , mutud 'a boso ńa Kirgis o ekombo .

entries.en: In 1993 , Ute , from Germany , now in her early 50 ' s , was assigned to serve as a missionary in Madagascar .
entries.dua: O mbu ma 1993 , Ute , nu wu o Jaman , ńe tatan 53 ma mbu , a ta a lomabe ̱ o bolea ka ńamuloloma o Madagaskar .

entries.en: In 1994 we reached another milestone when the first of our publications was printed in the Kyrgyz language .
entries.dua: O mbu 1994 , di po ̱ ngi tanga dipe ̱ pe ̱ ponda kalat 'asu ńaboso na eyem 'a Kirgis e busino ̱ .

entries.en: In 1995 a congregation was formed in Balykchy - eight years after our first visit to that town .
entries.dua: O mbu 1995 mwemba mu bokisabe ̱ o Balykchy - mimbu lombi ombusa pe ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ lasu laboso owo .

entries.en: In 2007 the Governing Body placed the schools taught at Bethel under the new Theocratic Schools Department , and for some years I was privileged to be the overseer .
entries.dua: O mbu má 2007 Dibe ̱ le ̱ di Madie ̱ le ̱ di te ̱ se ̱ besukulu be ta o Bete ̱ l owas 'a byombwedi ba Epep 'a Besukulu ba Bibe ̱ l ya peńa , na kusi edube ya be ̱ mombwed 'a y 'epepa mbu to ̱ mininga .

entries.en: In 2010 the Ministerial Training School was renamed the Bible School for Single Brothers , and a new school was formed , the Bible School for Christian Couples .
entries.dua: O mbu má 2010 Esukul 'a Belongedi ońol 'ebol 'a Janea e kusi dina la peńa la Esukul 'a Bibe ̱ l ońola bonasango be mulamba ; na esukul 'a peńa e bokabe ̱ , ye nde Esukul 'a Bibe ̱ l ońol 'a Kriste ̱ n i bai .

entries.en: In 2011 our lives changed completely when the Britain and Ireland branches were merged and we were assigned to London Bethel .
entries.dua: O mbu má 2011 , longe ̱ lasu di wengisan ná bambam ponda mikanjo m 'ebolo ma Inglisi na Ireland mi latino ̱ , di lomabe ̱ o Bete ̱ l a London .

entries.en: In 2012 , Perrine mustered up the courage , and she and Louis moved .
entries.dua: O mbu má 2012 nde Perrine a kusino ̱ ngiń 'a mulema o wala na Louis .

entries.en: In 2014 , Sylviana nevertheless teamed up with Sylvie Ann , a young pioneer sister in her congregation , and they moved to a small village 53 miles ( 85 km ) from their hometown .
entries.dua: O mbu má 2014 , Sylviana a lati na Sylvie Ann , eso ̱ mb 'a munańango ewo ̱ ye paonia o mwemba mao , na babo ̱ bala o son a mundi iwo ̱ ye etum a 85 ma kilometa na we ̱ ni ba majano ̱ .

entries.en: In 2014 / 2015 , some of the largest stadiums in 14 cities around the world became home for the three - day " Keep Seeking First God 's Kingdom ! "

entries.en: In 2015 , as a result of adjustments in the organization , Daniel and Miriam were asked to continue their service as regular pioneers .
