entries.dua: Ben byala ba Yesu ná , " lo jai te ̱ o eyal 'am , " be mapula nde o kwala ná jangame ̱ n o bola mambo mō ̱ , ná mo ̱ Yesu a te ̱ se ̱ biso ̱ wonja .

entries.en: Jesus ' whole life revolved around doing his Father 's will .
entries.dua: Longe ̱ la Yesu le ̱ se ̱ di ta nde ná a bole jemea la Sango .

entries.en: Jesus ' willingness to die while upholding Jehovah 's righteousness addresses matters of universal importance . - Heb .
entries.dua: Kwedi Yesu a bolino ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ na jemea , na sue ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ te ̱ me ̱ la sim la Yehova o mulemlem ma ponda e mabo ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ myambo ma mweńa ma misipo . - Bon .

entries.en: Jesus ' words spoken in the Sermon on the Mount give us clear guidance about setting goals .
entries.dua: Byala ba Yesu o ekwal 'ao o mudongo be mabola biso ̱ bediedi jombwea te ̱ se ̱ la mambo di mabupe ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus ' words that we read at John 5 : 22 , 23 help us to see that plainly : " The Father judges no one at all , but he has entrusted all the judging to the Son , so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father .
entries.dua: Byala ba Yesu di langino ̱ o Yohane 5 : 22 , 23 be mongwane ̱ biso ̱ o so ̱ ṅtane ̱ na bwē ninka ná : " Tete ̱ a si makaise ̱ to ̱ moto , nde a yoke ̱ ye ̱ Muna muka mwe ̱ se ̱ , ná be ̱ se ̱ ba bole Muna edube , kana ba mabolano ̱ Tete ̱ edube .

entries.en: Jesus ' yoke is kindly indeed !
entries.dua: Na mbale ̱ , eko ̱ ko ̱ s 'a Yesu e s 'ambi !

entries.en: Jesus , knowing that they were about to come and seize him to make him king , withdrew again to the mountain all alone .
entries.dua: Yesu a so ̱ ino ̱ ná ba me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ putea mo ̱ o timbise ̱ mo ̱ kiṅe ̱ , na mo ̱ a we ̱ nge ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ pe ̱ te ̱ omo ̱ ń a mudongo muso ̱ lo ̱ ki .

entries.en: Jesus , on the other hand , gave convincing evidence of being appointed by God , and he constantly glorified Jehovah as the Supreme Leader of his people .
entries.dua: O mune ̱ mudi , Yesu a lee ̱ le ̱ mbaki ni londi ná a ta a po ̱ so ̱ be ̱ na Loba ; a bola pe ̱ Yehova edube ponda ye ̱ se ̱ ka Mudiedi Ńasam ńa tumba lao .

entries.en: Jesus , on the other hand , truly loved the name of Jehovah .
entries.dua: Nde Yesu a ta a to ̱ ndo ̱ dina la Yehova na mbale ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus , then , condemned the practice of taking oaths lightly .
entries.dua: Yesu pe ̱ a te ̱ m te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ yen eboledi ya wamse ̱ la kana la so ̱ ngo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus , though , focuses on the steward 's reaction , not on the reasons for the dismissal .
entries.dua: Nde Yesu a soke ̱ nde mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ o nje muboledi a bolino ̱ seto ̱ o njo ̱ m a pangabe ̱ lao .

entries.en: Jesus allowed God 's Word to guide not only his actions but also his teaching .
entries.dua: Yesu ese ̱ le ̱ ná Eyal 'a Loba e die ̱ le ̱ seto ̱ buka te ̱ bebolo bao nde na belēdi bao pe ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus also drew close to Jehovah by studying the Scriptures .
entries.dua: 3 : 4 ) Yesu a sisedi pe ̱ be ̱ be ̱ na Yehova tongwea na jokwa la Betiledi .

entries.en: Jesus also said that love for one another would be the quality that would identify true Christians .
entries.dua: 22 : 37 - 39 ) Yesu a kwali pe ̱ ná ndol 'a mō ̱ na nune ̱ nde e me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ ede ̱ mo e me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ eyemban a Kriste ̱ n a mbale ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus also stated his neutral position to the Roman authorities .
entries.dua: Mu munia mu ta mu kwala ná , " mot 'edube " mō ̱ , nika ná Yesu , a ta ala o ekombo etum , o lo ̱ ndo ̱ la pond 'a bwaba .

entries.en: Jesus always listened obediently to his Father , even when doing so was very difficult .
entries.dua: Yesu a sengane ̱ Sango ponda ye ̱ se ̱ , to ̱ ponda bola la nika di tano ̱ ndutu . ( Mat .

entries.en: Jesus and his corulers , who together make up God 's Kingdom , will administer the benefits of the ransom to obedient mankind over a period of a thousand years .
entries.dua: Wase e me ̱ nde ̱ timbisabe ̱ paradisi , mbel 'a moto ńa jemea ńe ̱ se ̱ pe ̱ e po ̱ o ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus answered : " My Kingdom is no part of this world . "
entries.dua: Nde Yesu alabe ̱ mo ̱ ná : " Janea lam di titi la nin wase . "

entries.en: Jesus assured her : " Your brother will rise . "
entries.dua: Yesu a boli mo ̱ mbaki ná : " Munańo ̱ ngo ̱ a me ̱ nde ̱ pumbwa . "

entries.en: Jesus assured his faithful apostles that they would rule with him in heaven .
entries.dua: Yesu a boli bamuloloma bao ba jemea mbaki ná ba me ̱ nde ̱ janea o mo ̱ ń mwemba na mo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus became the ransom sacrifice that opened the way to endless life " for many " - men , women , and children .
entries.dua: 2 : 6 ) Yesu nde a timbi jabea la diko ̱ ti di tele ̱ nge 'a longe ̱ di si be ̱ n su " ońola jita " - bome , bito , na bana . ( Mat .

entries.en: Jesus came to earth and died " once for all time . "
entries.dua: Yesu a po ̱ i o wase , a wo ̱ " ngedi po ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus Christ , through his anointed brothers and supportive " princes " of the other sheep , provides encouragement and guidance to despondent and discouraged ones in this time of need .
entries.dua: Yesu Kristo a mabolane ̱ bonasango bo ̱ kisabe ̱ na " banedi " ba masue ̱ le ̱ mido ̱ ngi mipe ̱ pe ̱ , nika ná batudu , o jembe ̱ na die ̱ le ̱ bamilema mi yuki , na babo ̱ bi milema o nin ponda di be ̱ nno ̱ ńo ̱ ng 'a kusa jembame ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus Christ set the perfect example for you young ones .
entries.dua: Yesu a die ̱ le ̱ bińo ̱ beso ̱ mbe ̱ eyembilan e peti bwam .

entries.en: Jesus Christ stressed that " the good news has to be preached first . "
entries.dua: Yesu Kristo a kwali ná " myango ma bwam mangame ̱ n se ̱ le ̱ langwabe ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus concluded his story by telling the scribe to be like that Samaritan .
entries.dua: O kwese ̱ l 'ekwal 'ao Yesu a kwalane ̱ nu mubied 'a mbenda ná a be ̱ ka nu mot 'a Samaria .

entries.en: Jesus condemned racial pride .
entries.dua: Yesu okwe ̱ le ̱ ná kumb 'a tumba ńe bobe .

entries.en: Jesus confirmed the seriousness of making vows when he stated : " It was said to those of ancient times : ' You must not swear without performing , but you must pay your vows to Jehovah . ' " - Matt .
entries.dua: ( Mul . 5 : 4 ) Yesu a bamse ̱ mweńa ma bola kakane ̱ ponda a kwalino ̱ ná : " E ta e kwalabe ̱ bato ba kwaṅ ná : O si kana so ̱ ngo ̱ a mawo ̱ ndo ̱ n , nde londise ̱ ye ̱ Sango so ̱ ngo ̱ ango ̱ . " - Mat .

entries.en: Jesus contributed to the sanctification of the divine name .
entries.dua: ( Yohane 17 : 25 , 26 ) Yesu a no ̱ ngi dongo o sangisabe ̱ la dina la Loba .

entries.en: Jesus described Jehovah as " the cultivator , " himself as " the true vine , " and his disciples as " the branches . "
entries.dua: Yesu a langisane ̱ Yehova na " mupo ̱ nge ̱ mōnda , " mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na " mudiki ma wań " ( m.o.d ) , bokwedi bao pe ̱ na " mikanjo . "

entries.en: Jesus did not feel the need to enumerate the disciples ' shortcomings , including what they had done on the night he was arrested .
entries.dua: Yesu a se ̱ n bwam o botea langa mawuse ̱ ma bokwedi bao , nate ̱ na mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ nje ba bolino ̱ bo bulu a damabe ̱ le ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus did not urge his followers to get swords for protection .
entries.dua: Yesu a s 'anedi bokwedi bao ná baleye njombe o tata babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus displayed a perfectly balanced view of pleasures .
entries.dua: Yesu a lee ̱ le ̱ be ̱ la skwe ̱ jombwea muńe ̱ nge ̱ ma ńolo .

entries.en: Jesus does not indicate whether the accusation was valid .
entries.dua: Yesu a si bamse ̱ nga nje ba bake ̱ le ̱ no ̱ muboledi e ta mbale ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus emphatically warned his disciples to stay clear of the teachings , or leaven , that these three groups advocated .
entries.dua: Yesu ome ̱ le ̱ so ̱ bokwedi bao ná ba no ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ belēdi , to ̱ so ̱ esasang 'a man mańaṅ malalo jangame ̱ ye ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus encouraged this sort of faith , telling a rich young man : " If you want to be perfect , go sell your belongings and give to the poor , and you will have treasure in heaven ; and come be my follower . "
entries.dua: ( Bbot . 14 : 22 , 23 ) Yesu a ta a do ̱ lisane ̱ ni ńai a dube ̱ , a kwalane ̱ eso ̱ mb 'a m 'bwaṅ ma moto ná : " O mapula te ̱ be ̱ ná ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ , ala , wandise ̱ me ̱ se ̱ o be ̱ nno ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus enjoyed teaching people about his heavenly Father .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta muńe ̱ nge ̱ o jokwe ̱ le ̱ bato jombwea Sango ao ńe omo ̱ ń .

entries.en: Jesus even gave his own life in behalf of mankind , though many hated him .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 7 : 22 ) Yesu a boli na mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ lao ońola mbel 'a moto , to ̱ ná jita ba tano ̱ ba singe ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus even washed the feet of his apostles .
entries.dua: 20 : 28 ) Yesu ou na myende ma bamuloloma bao .

entries.en: Jesus exercises his headship over his congregation with loving patience .
entries.dua: ( Efe . 5 : 23 ) Yesu ńe mulopo ma mwemba a malee ̱ le ̱ ndolo na we ̱ lisane ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus firmly rebuked them .
entries.dua: Nde Yesu a domedi babo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus followed that illustration with a reference to the prophetic statement at Psalm 118 : 22 , which he quoted .
entries.dua: Ombusa mo ̱ bola mu munia , Yesu a kiki Myenge 118 : 22 , me nde edinge ̱ .

entries.en: JESUS foretold that his followers would enjoy an abundant harvest in this time of the end .
entries.dua: YESU a ta a bīse ̱ ná bokwedi bao ba me ̱ nde ̱ bwane ̱ tute ̱ ńa mumbwa muńe ̱ nge ̱ o min mińa misukan .

entries.en: Jesus found joy in every one of his assignments , and we can find joy in ours .
entries.dua: Yesu a bwane ̱ m 'bē ̱ mao te ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ , biso ̱ pe ̱ je ná di bwane ̱ masu muńe ̱ nge ̱ mulemlem .

entries.en: Jesus gave this simple rule for combating propaganda : " Know the truth , and the truth will set you free . "
entries.dua: Yesu a boli ben byanedi be wam , o bwam ba janane ̱ camane ̱ la mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ : " Lo me ̱ nde ̱ bia mbale ̱ , nde mbale ̱ e me ̱ nde ̱ timbise ̱ bińo ̱ wonja . "

entries.en: Jesus grew up to be a happy adult .
entries.dua: O bokoka bao , Yesu a ta muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus had earlier prepared them for such an extensive assignment by drawing their attention to good qualities in foreigners .
entries.dua: ( Bebolo 1 : 8 ) Ná a boṅsane ̱ babo ̱ o kwalisane ̱ pat 'a bato ye ̱ se ̱ , Yesu a ta be ̱ a kwalisane ̱ babo ̱ ońola bede ̱ mo ba bwam ba be ̱ n ba bato .

entries.en: Jesus had foreseen that many of his followers would be forced from their homes .
entries.dua: ( Bebolo 8 : 1 ) Yesu e ̱ n oboso ba ponda ná jita la bokwedi bao ba me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ eto ̱ m o dia mamboa mabu .

entries.en: Jesus had given his followers a commission : " You will be witnesses of me in Jerusalem , in all Judea and Samaria , and to the most distant part of the earth . "
entries.dua: Yesu a bake ̱ bokwedi bao ebolo : " Lo me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ mboṅ am o Yerusalem na o Yudea ńe ̱ se ̱ na o Samaria , nate ̱ na o masu ma wase . "

entries.en: Jesus has also been busy refining God 's people and helping them to render worship that is clean . - Mal .
entries.dua: 24 : 45 ) Yesu a walame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ o timbise ̱ le ̱ tumba la Loba ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ , na jongwane ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ o sangise ̱ jowe ̱ lao . - Mal .

entries.en: Jesus highlighted their attitude toward offenders by relating an illustration of a Pharisee who prayed : " O God , I thank you that I am not like everyone else - extortioners , unrighteous , adulterers - or even like this tax collector " - a tax collector who was humbly praying for God 's mercy .
entries.dua: Ná a sambwe ̱ le ̱ ebe ̱ yed 'abu ya bobe o mbasanedi ma bawusi , Yesu a no ̱ ngi edinge ̱ ding 'a Farisai ńe o kane ̱ o mbasanedi ma muko ̱ tedi ná : " A Loba , na som wa ná na titi ka bane ̱ bato , bato ba ndumban , basite ̱ m na sim , bamusonje , to ̱ ka nun muko ̱ tedi . " - nde ke ̱ muko ̱ tedi e o kane ̱ na sibise ̱ la ńolo ná a kusane ̱ Loba ndedi .

entries.en: Jesus himself made such a connection .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ a kwaledi nika .

entries.en: Jesus himself received encouragement from his Father .
entries.dua: Yehova embe ̱ pe ̱ Mun 'ao Yesu .

entries.en: Jesus himself was subjected to prejudice .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ a langabe ̱ ndando .

entries.en: Jesus imitated his Father 's example .
entries.dua: Yesu a bupe ̱ eyembilan a Sango .

entries.en: Jesus included the pain of family opposition as part of the suffering that his followers must be willing to endure .
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná mitakisan mi mawe ̱ na mbia me nde lambo diwo ̱ la ma mena bokwedi bao ba me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ kusa .

entries.en: Jesus knew that he would be facing his final test alone .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bia ná a me ̱ nde ̱ nde lembe ̱ kekise ̱ lao disukan muso ̱ lo ̱ ki .

entries.en: Jesus knew that his teachings would divide people and that those who follow him would need courage to do so in the face of opposition .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bia ná belēdi bao be me ̱ nde ̱ jaba bato , na ná bokwedi bao ba me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ ńo ̱ ng 'a ngiń 'a mulema o lembe ̱ mitakisan .

entries.en: Jesus knew that like the steward who found himself in a difficult situation , most of Jesus ' followers would need to make a living in this unjust commercial world .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bia ná ka nu muboledi nu so ̱ be ̱ o bete ̱ medi ba ndutu , jita la bokwedi bao ba me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ ńo ̱ ngi o sombwea babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ o nin was 'a ńunga ni si te ̱ m na sim .

entries.en: Jesus likened himself to a vine , or stem , and his followers to branches .
entries.dua: Yesu a langisane ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ na mudiki ma wań , to ̱ so ̱ botina , bokwedi bao pe ̱ mikanjo .

entries.en: Jesus likewise has been willing to wait .
entries.dua: Yesu pe ̱ a ta a le ̱ le ̱ me ̱ o we ̱ lisane ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus loved God 's Word , and he was eager to share it with others .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 24 : 32 , 45 ) Yesu a ta a to ̱ ndo ̱ Eyal 'a Loba , a ta pe ̱ a le ̱ le ̱ me ̱ o langwea mo ̱ bape ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: JESUS loved the Mosaic Law .
entries.dua: YESU a ta a to ̱ ndo ̱ Mbend 'a Mose .

entries.en: Jesus makes it clear that Jehovah will not forgive us if we do not forgive our brothers when there is a sound basis for doing so .
entries.dua: Yesu a teleye ̱ ná bwē ná Yehova a si me ̱ nde ̱ lakise ̱ biso ̱ , yete ̱ na di si lakise ̱ bonasango asu ke ̱ bate ̱ le ̱ na mbale ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus mentioned the sanctification of God 's name as the first request in his model prayer .
entries.dua: Lambo laboso Yesu a to ̱ pedino ̱ o muka mao mwena mwe pe ̱ nde patan a muka le nde sangisabe ̱ la dina la Loba .

entries.en: Jesus once invited a tax collector named Matthew Levi , saying : " Be my follower . "
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bele ̱ muko ̱ tedi Mateo Levi , a kwalane ̱ mo ̱ ná : " Bupe ̱ mba ! "

entries.en: Jesus promised that any sacrifices we make to worship Jehovah will be richly rewarded . - Mark 10 : 28 - 30 .
entries.dua: Yesu a kakane ̱ ná mabea me ̱ se ̱ di mabolano ̱ o jowe ̱ Yehova ma me ̱ nde ̱ kusa musawedi munde ̱ ne ̱ . - Marko 10 : 28 - 30 .

entries.en: Jesus promised that the Father in heaven would eagerly " give holy spirit to those asking him . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kakane ̱ ná Sango ńe o mo ̱ ń e muńe ̱ nge ̱ o " bola ba ba mapulane ̱ mo ̱ mudī - musangi . "

entries.en: Jesus proved his love for mankind by willingly carrying out God 's will .
entries.dua: Yesu a lee ̱ ndol 'ao ońola mbel 'a moto tongwea na londe ̱ na jemea le ̱ se ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la Loba .

entries.en: Jesus recognized the need to rest on occasion .
entries.dua: 2 : 24 ) Yesu embi mweńa ma wumse ̱ ponda iwo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus recognized this harsh reality with the words : " You always have the poor with you . "
entries.dua: Yesu embi yen ebe ̱ yed 'a mambo ya ndedi na ben byala ná : " Ebanja batuedi be na bińo ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus repeatedly exhorted his disciples : " Keep on the watch . "
entries.dua: Yesu ome ̱ le ̱ bokwedi bao ngedi jita ná : " Bińo ̱ ja peńa . "

entries.en: Jesus replied : " Healthy people do not need a physician , but those who are ill do .
entries.dua: Yesu alabe ̱ nde babo ̱ ná : " Ba ba jai bwam ba si mapula mubole ̱ myanga , ke ̱ baboedi .

entries.en: Jesus rightly called them his friends .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ o bele ̱ babo ̱ ná mako ̱ m .

entries.en: Jesus said : " Abraham your father rejoiced greatly at the prospect of seeing my day . "
entries.dua: 22 : 15 - 18 ; Bon . 11 : 10 ) Yesu a kwali ná : " Sango ańu Abraham a ta a sombise ̱ ná a me ̱ nde ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ buńa bam . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " Do not fear those who kill the body and after this are not able to do anything more . "
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " Lo si bwa ba bo ̱ ngo ̱ , bena ba mabwe ̱ ńolo , nde ombusa nika ba si we ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ bola to ̱ lambo . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " Do not think I came to bring peace to the earth ; I came to bring , not peace , but a sword .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " Lo s 'o ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná na po ̱ i nde o wana musango o wase ; na si po ̱ i wana musango , nde po ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus said : " Go . . . make disciples of people . . . teaching them . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " Bińo ̱ ala so ̱ , timbise ̱ matumba me ̱ se ̱ bokwedi bam . . . na lee ̱ babo ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " If anyone wants to come after me , let him disown himself and pick up his torture stake and keep following me . "
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " To ̱ nja nu mapule ̱ bupe ̱ mba a to ̱ be mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ , a bambe ̱ [ ebongo ao ya konjo , NW ] , nde a bupe ̱ mba . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " Keep on , then , seeking first the Kingdom and his righteousness , and all these other things [ basic material needs ] will be added to you . "
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " Bińo ̱ se ̱ le ̱ nde pulise ̱ Janea la Loba na te ̱ me ̱ lao la sim , nde man me ̱ se ̱ ma me ̱ nde ̱ batabe ̱ le ̱ bińo ̱ . " ( Mat .

entries.en: Jesus said : " No man can come to me unless the Father , who sent me , draws him . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " To ̱ moto a titi ná a we ̱ le ̱ po ̱ na mba , yete ̱ na Tete ̱ nu lom mba a si duti mo ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " No one can slave for two masters ; for either he will hate the one and love the other , or he will stick to the one and despise the other .
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " To ̱ moto a titi ná a we ̱ le ̱ bolea basango baba ; e be ̱ te ̱ ná a masinge ̱ mō ̱ , a to ̱ ndo ̱ nune ̱ ; to ̱ a matingame ̱ na mō ̱ , a yaṅa nune ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus said : " No one can slave for two masters ; for either he will hate the one and love the other , or he will stick to the one and despise the other .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " To ̱ moto a titi ná a we ̱ le ̱ bolea basango baba ; e be ̱ te ̱ ná a masinge ̱ mō ̱ , a to ̱ ndo ̱ nune ̱ ; to ̱ a matingame ̱ na mō ̱ , a yaṅa nune ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus said : " No one has love greater than this , that someone should surrender his life in behalf of his friends . "
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " To ̱ moto a si be ̱ n ndolo ninde ̱ ne ̱ buka nu nu mabole ̱ longe ̱ lao ońola mako ̱ m mao . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " These things I have spoken to you , so that my joy may be in you and your joy may be made full . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " Na kwalan bińo ̱ nika , ná muńe ̱ nge ̱ mam mu be ̱ na bińo ̱ , ná muńe ̱ nge ̱ mańu mu londe mbom . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " When such [ unrighteous riches ] fail , " not ' if they fail . '
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " Yete ̱ na [ bema ba wase be si te ̱ m na sim ] be bo ̱ i te ̱ , " seto ̱ ná ' ponda be me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ bo ̱ . '

entries.en: Jesus said : " Where your treasure is , there your heart will be also . "
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " Ebanja wuma diwuta lo ̱ ngo ̱ la bema leno ̱ , oten pe ̱ nde mulema mo ̱ ngo ̱ mu mabe ̱ no ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus said : " Where your treasure is , there your hearts will be also . " - Luke 12 : 34 .
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " Wuma diwuta lańu la bema leno ̱ , oten pe ̱ nde mulema mańu mu mabe ̱ no ̱ . " - Lukas 12 : 34 .

entries.en: Jesus said : " You must love your neighbor as yourself . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : " To ̱ ndo ̱ munaso ̱ ngo ̱ ka wame ̱ ne ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus said that if we were to put any human before him , we would not be worthy of him .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná di to ̱ ndi te ̱ moto nupe ̱ pe ̱ buka mo ̱ ke ̱ di s 'angame ̱ n mo ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus said that this work would be carried out by his true disciples .
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná bokwedi bao ba mbale ̱ nde ba me ̱ nde ̱ bole ̱ y 'ebolo .

entries.en: Jesus said to his disciples : " Take my yoke upon you . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwalane ̱ bokwedi bao ná : " Bambe ̱ eko ̱ ko ̱ s 'am omo ̱ ń ańu . "

entries.en: Jesus set the pattern in honoring others by performing the lowliest of tasks .
entries.dua: Yesu a boli bebolo be mabolabe ̱ nde na basadi o lee ̱ le ̱ patan a ne ̱ ni bola bape ̱ pe ̱ edube .

entries.en: Jesus set the standard in balancing secular interests and spiritual matters .
entries.dua: Yesu a dī eyembilan e malee ̱ biso ̱ ne ̱ ni be ̱ skwe ̱ o nje e mombweye ̱ myam ma wase na mambo ma mudī .

entries.en: Jesus sets the example . - John 13 : 15 .
entries.dua: Yesu a boli biso ̱ eyembilan . - Yohane 13 : 15 .

entries.en: Jesus showed great love for others .
entries.dua: Yesu a lee ̱ le ̱ ndolo ninde ̱ ne ̱ ońola bape ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus showed that a Samaritan could teach the Jews the meaning of true neighborly love .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 10 : 25 - 37 ) Yesu a lee ̱ ná mot 'a Samaria e ná okwe ̱ le ̱ Bajū nje ye ndol 'a bonasango ńa mbale ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus spoke of a tragedy involving 18 people who were killed when a tower fell on them , and he indicated that those fatalities were not as a result of God 's will .
entries.dua: Yesu a to ̱ pedi ońola mbeu a ńolo ni kweledi 18 la bato bena ba bo ̱ lo ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ labu ponda njongo e kwedino ̱ babo ̱ omo ̱ ń , a langwa pe ̱ ná i mbeu a ńolo ye ̱ se ̱ i si ta jemea la Loba .

entries.en: Jesus spoke of his disciples ' angels looking upon the face of God .
entries.dua: Yesu a kwaledi ońola ange ̱ l a bokwedi bao ná i me ̱ ne ̱ boso ba Tete ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus stated : " Everyone who keeps on looking at a woman so as to have a passion for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart .
entries.dua: Yesu mo ̱ ná : " To ̱ nja nu mombwe ̱ muto na bepuledi ba bobe , ke ̱ a máwite ̱ nde musonje o mulema mao .

entries.en: Jesus stated : " No matter what you ask the Father in my name , he [ will ] give it to you . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná : ' To ̱ nje lo maso ̱ so ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ no ̱ Tete ̱ o dina lam , a [ me ̱ nde ̱ ] bola bińo ̱ mo ̱ . '

entries.en: Jesus stated that " no one can slave for two masters . " He added : " You cannot slave for God and for Riches . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná " to ̱ moto a titi ná a bolea basango baba " A bati pe ̱ ná : " Lo titi ná lo bolea Loba , nde lo bolea pe ̱ bema ba wase . "

entries.en: Jesus stated that Jehovah gives " holy spirit to those asking him . "
entries.dua: Yesu a kwali ná Yehova a mabola " ba ba mapulane ̱ mo ̱ Mudī - musangi . "

entries.en: Jesus stressed the need for endurance by using forms of the word " remain " over and over in the brief passage recorded at John 15 : 4 - 10 .
entries.dua: Yesu a bolane ̱ eyal 'a " ja " ngedi jita o yi son epas 'a Betiledi ya Yohane 15 : 4 - 10 , ná bokwedi bao ba so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná e me ̱ nde ̱ pula ná ba be ̱ titimbe ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus taught his disciples that they must maintain neutrality in these circumstances .
entries.dua: Yesu okwe ̱ le ̱ bokwedi bao ná ba si no ̱ ngo ̱ dongo o ma mambo .

entries.en: Jesus taught his followers a fundamental principle that underlies our unity .
entries.dua: Yesu okwe ̱ le ̱ bokwedi bao bete ̱ sedi ba mweńa be makike ̱ jalatane ̱ lasu .

entries.en: Jesus taught that God 's spirit can bring back to our mind things that we have learned .
entries.dua: Yesu okwe ̱ le ̱ ná mudī ma Loba mwe ná mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ mambo jokono ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus taught that the only Scriptural ground for dissolving a marriage vow is when an innocent mate chooses not to forgive an adulterous partner .
entries.dua: Yesu okwe ̱ le ̱ ná njo ̱ m a Betiledi po ̱ na mune ńa kwese ̱ la kakane ̱ la diba ńe nde ke ̱ nu nu wo ̱ ndo ̱ be ̱ oteten a babaedi a bangi o lakise ̱ mwenj 'ao nu wite ̱ musonje . ( Mat .

entries.en: Jesus then performed a miracle .
entries.dua: Na Yesu a po ̱ ngo ̱ betańsedi .

entries.en: Jesus thus became a perfect human , just as Adam had been .
entries.dua: ( Yohane 1 : 14 ) Na nika so ̱ nde Yesu a timbino ̱ be ̱ moto ńe ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ , mulemlem kana Adam a tano ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus thus revealed that baptism would be a requirement for those who accept the yoke of Christian discipleship .
entries.dua: Yesu a lee ̱ le ̱ so ̱ ná be ̱ se ̱ ba memeye ̱ bambe ̱ eko ̱ ko ̱ so ̱ o be ̱ bokwedi ba Kristo bangame ̱ n o dubisabe ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus told an illustration about a merchant who was seeking pearls .
entries.dua: Yesu a boli eyembilan a mot 'a ńunga nu ta nu wasa musanga .

entries.en: Jesus told his apostles : " My Father is glorified in this , that you keep bearing much fruit . "
entries.dua: Yesu a langwedi bamuloloma bao ná : " Tete ̱ a mabusisabe ̱ nde n 'edube , ke ̱ lo maya bepuma jita . "

entries.en: Jesus told his disciples : " By this all will know that you are my disciples - if you have love among yourselves . "
entries.dua: Yesu a langwedi bokwedi bao ná : " Nika nde be ̱ se ̱ ba me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ jemba ná le bokwedi bam , yete ̱ na lo be ̱ n ndolo mō ̱ na nune ̱ . "

entries.en: Jesus told his disciples not only to be in his love but to " remain in [ his ] love . "
entries.dua: ( Marko 12 : 30 ; Yohane 14 : 15 ) Yesu a si langwedi bokwedi bao buka te ̱ ná ba be ̱ o ndol 'ao , nde ná ba ' je o ndol ' [ ao ] , ' nika ná ba tingame ̱ o ndol 'ao .

entries.en: Jesus understood that the current economic system would not change until God 's Kingdom comes .
entries.dua: Yesu a so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná ebe ̱ yed 'a ńung 'a nin wase e si me ̱ nde ̱ tukwa nate ̱ na Janea la Loba di po ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus urged his disciples to let their light shine to glorify God .
entries.dua: Yesu ome ̱ le ̱ bokwedi bao ná bese ̱ le ̱ ná mwe ̱ ne ̱ n mabu mu pańe o sesa Yehova .

entries.en: Jesus warned his followers : " The hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think he has offered a sacred service to God . "
entries.dua: ( Yes . 5 : 20 ) Yesu ome ̱ le ̱ bokwedi bao ná : " Ponda e me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ , ńena to ̱ nja nu mabwe ̱ bińo ̱ a me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná a mabolea nde Loba . "

entries.en: Jesus was " mild - tempered . "
entries.dua: Yesu a ta " pī . " ( Mat .

entries.en: Jesus was a perfect man .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus was aware of this shameful strategy , so during his final meal with the apostles , he asked them to get some swords .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bia mun mwano ma iso ̱ n , ońola nika nde o da lao disukan na bamuloloma bao a baise ̱ no ̱ babo ̱ ná baleye po ̱ to ̱ ininga .

entries.en: Jesus was careful to remain neutral on the taxation issue .
entries.dua: Yesu a bolane ̱ so ̱ jangwa ná a si no ̱ ngo ̱ dongo o ekwal 'a tax .

entries.en: JESUS was concerned about unity during his final supper with his apostles .
entries.dua: YESU a kwaledi ońola jalatane ̱ o ponda da lao disukan na bamuloloma bao .

entries.en: Jesus was confident that Jehovah would send angelic help whenever he needed it to accomplish God 's will . - Matt .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 22 : 43 ) Yesu a ta a lakisane ̱ ná Yehova a me ̱ nde ̱ loma ange ̱ l o jongwane ̱ mo ̱ to ̱ njika ponda e tano ̱ e pula ná a londise ̱ jemea la Loba . - Mat .

entries.en: Jesus was Jehovah 's choice .
entries.dua: Na mbale ̱ Yesu nde Yehova a po ̱ sino ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus was keenly aware of the pressures associated with the anxieties of this system of things .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bia njika ndutu na mutaka be o yen ebe ̱ yed 'a mambo ya nin wase .

entries.en: Jesus was not alone in condemning these abuses .
entries.dua: Seto ̱ Yesu buka te ̱ nde a ta a te ̱ me ̱ te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ ben beboledi .

entries.en: Jesus was rejected as the Messiah and killed .
entries.dua: Yesu a ta a bangabe ̱ ka Mesia , a bwabe ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus was resurrected to be " the chief cornerstone " ( See paragraphs 8 , 9 )
entries.dua: Yesu a pumbwabe ̱ le ̱ o be ̱ " dale la tóngo " ( Ombwa mongo 8 , 9 )

entries.en: Jesus was sent to provide comfort for " the brokenhearted " and " all who mourn . "
entries.dua: ( Yohane 5 : 19 ) Yesu a ta a lomabe ̱ o wanea " batakedi " na " bandutu " lo ̱ ko ̱ mea .

entries.en: Jesus was teaching Martha a valuable lesson .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 10 : 38 - 42 ) Yesu a ta nde okwe ̱ le ̱ Marta belēdi ba mweńa .

entries.en: Jesus was without sin , so he did not need to repent .
entries.dua: 3 : 13 - 17 ) Yesu a si boli bobe to ̱ bō ̱ , a si ta so ̱ a be ̱ ne ̱ ńo ̱ ng 'a jate ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: Jesus went on to explain : " Every doer of sin is a slave of sin . . . .
entries.dua: Yesu alane ̱ beteledi oboso ná : " To ̱ nja nu mabole ̱ bobe e nde mukom a bobe . . . .

entries.en: Jesus will crush the serpent 's head and erase from the universe all traces of Satan 's rebellion . - Gen .
entries.dua: 5 : 13 ; 20 : 6 ) Yesu a me ̱ nde ̱ ńo ̱ so ̱ mulopo ma Satan , a dimse ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ njika muse ̱ se ̱ le ̱ ma pamo a Satan o misipo . - Bbo .

entries.en: Jewish historian Josephus states that this Judas " incited his countrymen to revolt , upbraiding them as cowards for consenting to pay tribute to the Romans . "
entries.dua: Yosefus mulangwe ̱ myango mō ̱ ńa Bajū a lango jombwea nu Yuda ná , " a tute ̱ le ̱ bato b 'ekombo ná banane ̱ Roma , a bele ̱ pe ̱ be ̱ se ̱ ba ta ba sawea Roma tax ná babo ̱ ngo ̱ . "

entries.en: Jewish historical records show that temple merchants exploited their customers by charging exorbitant prices .
entries.dua: Myango ma longe ̱ la Baju mi malee ̱ ná bandise ̱ ńunga o tempe ̱ l ba ta ba susane ̱ bandedi mususedi munde ̱ ne ̱ ná ba dumbe babo ̱ .

entries.en: Jewish law required that those sentenced to death be buried before sundown .
entries.dua: Mbend 'a Bonayuda e ta e kwala ná be ̱ se ̱ ba kusi mbako a kwedi ba pulame ̱ o bo buńa me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: Jewish leaders likewise heaped scorn on Jesus ' followers .
entries.dua: Badiedi b 'ebas 'a Bajū pe ̱ ba ta ba me ̱ ngise ̱ bokwedi ba Yesu .

entries.en: Jewish religious leaders would not talk to a woman in public , let alone a Samaritan woman with a questionable reputation .
entries.dua: ( Yohane 4 : 9 , 27 ) Badiedi b 'ebas 'a Bonayuda ba si ta ba kwalisane ̱ muto o myoso ma bato , ngedi ininga na mut 'a Samaria nu si ta nu be ̱ ne ̱ dina la bwam .

entries.en: Jewish Zealots , or nationalists , stirred up these feelings among the people .
entries.dua: Dińaṅ la politik la Bonayuda ba pamo , ba tano ̱ ba bele ̱ ná Selot , di ta di tute ̱ le ̱ bato o be ̱ pamo .

entries.en: Job 's experience also highlights our need to show compassion to fellow Christians who may be enduring hardships .
entries.dua: Eyembilan a Hiob e malee ̱ pe ̱ ná jangame ̱ n o lee ̱ le ̱ bonasango be oteten a mitakisan nded 'a mulema .

entries.en: Job ?
entries.dua: Hiob

entries.en: Job ?
entries.dua: Hiob e ?

entries.en: Job also saw many of God 's invisible qualities in the visible creation .
entries.dua: Hiob e ̱ n pe ̱ bedidi ba Loba , nika ná bede ̱ mo bao be si me ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ tongwea na mambo a wekino ̱ .

entries.en: Job could not know when in the future that time would be .
entries.dua: Hiob a si ta a bia njika ponda nika e me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ bolane ̱ o kie ̱ le ̱ ni maye ̱ .

entries.en: Job had been dead for many centuries when Ezekiel recorded the words of our theme text .
entries.dua: Hiob a ta a máwo ̱ bebwea ba mimbu ombusa Hesekiel tila byala ba te ̱ xt ni masue ̱ le ̱ din jokwa .

entries.en: Job had outstanding insight into godly principles .
entries.dua: Hiob a ta a be ̱ ne ̱ so ̱ ṅtane ̱ dinde ̱ ne ̱ la bete ̱ sedi ba Loba .

entries.en: Job refused to turn his back on God .
entries.dua: Hiob a bangi jumbe ̱ Loba mbusa .

entries.en: Job rejected all forms of idolatry - even in his heart .
entries.dua: Hiob a ta a singe ̱ ńai a jowe ̱ la losango ye ̱ se ̱ - nate ̱ na o mulema mao .

entries.en: Job was not an Israelite .
entries.dua: Hiob a si ta mot 'a Bonaisrael .

entries.en: Johannes
entries.dua: Yohannes

entries.en: John 's authority was challenged ; so was that of the apostle Paul .
entries.dua: Bō ̱ ba ta ba te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ doi la byanedi la Yohane , name ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na la ńamuloloma Paulo .

entries.en: John 's reason for writing to Gaius was not just to thank him .
entries.dua: Yohane a si tiledi Gayo buka te ̱ o timbise ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ masoma .

entries.en: John 's three letters contain further gems of truth .
entries.dua: Maleta ma ńamuloloma Yohane malalo ma be ̱ n misanga ma tiki ma mbale ̱ mipe ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: John 's words of appreciation for the hospitality that Gaius showed to the brothers indicate that Christians regularly traveled between the apostle John 's location and the congregations , and these travelers evidently told John about what they had encountered .
entries.dua: Byala ba Yohane ba musesako ońola ede ̱ mo a kasa la bonasango ya Gayo be malee ̱ ná Kriste ̱ n i ta be ̱ yala o malo ̱ ndo ̱ , jasumwe ̱ wuma ńamuloloma Yohane a tano ̱ , wala o myemba , ye ̱ ke ̱ i te ̱ ban bonasango bena ba ta be ̱ bala o ma malo ̱ ndo ̱ ba langwedi Yohane nje ba tano ̱ ba kusa owo .

entries.en: John 19 : 38 says that Joseph " was a disciple of Jesus but a secret one because of his fear of the Jews . "
entries.dua: Yohane 19 : 38 mo ̱ ná Yose ̱ f " a ta mokwed 'a Yesu , nde o diwuta ońola bo ̱ ngo ̱ ba Bonayuda . "

entries.en: John alone wrote that " God is love . "
entries.dua: ( 1 Yohane 3 : 20 ) Yohane mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ nde a tili ná " Loba e nde ndolo . "

entries.en: John also wanted to help him deal with a serious problem .
entries.dua: Yohane a ta pe ̱ nde a pula jongwane ̱ mo ̱ o lembe ̱ mitakisan ma ngińa mō ̱ .

entries.en: John as well as his five brothers and sisters and their mother were all staunch Roman Catholics and as such were opposed to the father 's faith .
entries.dua: Yohane na bandome ̱ bao ba bome na ba bito batanu na ńango abu ba ta nde bembon ba ko ̱ di b 'ebas 'a Pata ya Roma , ba ta so ̱ ba te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ dube ̱ la sango abu .

entries.en: John considered this to be proof of Gaius ' faithfulness , since showing hospitality has always distinguished God 's servants . - Gen .
entries.dua: Yohane a langi nika ka lambo di mabole ̱ mboṅ ná Gayo e jemea , kana ede ̱ mo a kasa la be ̱ n e tano ̱ e we ̱ le ̱ bautu ba Loba tobotobo . - Bbot .

entries.en: John encouraged Gaius to show hospitality again , for the apostle asked him to " send [ the travelers ] on their way in a manner worthy of God . "
entries.dua: Yohane embe ̱ Gayo ná a bate lee ̱ le ̱ ede ̱ mo a kasa la be ̱ n , ebanja ńamuloloma a ta a baise ̱ mo ̱ ná a " boṅsane ̱ babo ̱ [ be ̱ n ] lo ̱ ndo ̱ , kana yangame ̱ nno ̱ oboso ba Loba . "

entries.en: John had just referred to God ( see verse 6 ) , so the expression " in behalf of his name " appears to refer to Jehovah 's name .
entries.dua: ( 3 Yohane 7 ) Yohane a ta nde a wa tuba dina la Loba ( ombwa mwemba 6 ) , ben byala ná " ońola di dina " be makwalea nde dina la Yehova .

entries.en: John had the unique privilege of baptizing Jesus , the perfect human Son of God .
entries.dua: Yohane a kusi mpo ̱ m mō ̱ na mpete ̱ m 'edube o dubise ̱ Yesu , Mun 'a Loba nu ta mot 'a benama ńe ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ . ( Mat .

entries.en: John may have wanted to know whether someone else would fulfill all the hopes of the Jews .
entries.dua: 11 : 2 , 3 ) Yohane a puli nde o bia nga moto nupe ̱ pe ̱ e , nu me ̱ nde ̱ londise ̱ mapita me ̱ se ̱ ma Bajū .

entries.en: John praised Gaius for hosting the brothers even though they were strangers to him .
entries.dua: Yohane a sesi Gayo ońola kasa lao la bonasango to ̱ na ba tano ̱ nde mo ̱ be ̱ n .

entries.en: John said : " It was in behalf of his name that they went out . "
entries.dua: Yohane a kwali ná : " Ebanja ońola di dina nde ba busino ̱ . "

entries.en: John started to study with the Witnesses , took his stand for true worship , and began serving Jehovah .
entries.dua: Yohane a botedi so ̱ jokwa Bibe ̱ l na Mboṅ a Yehova , a te ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ o mudi ma jowe ̱ la mbale ̱ , a botea bolea Yehova .

entries.en: John therefore told Gaius and , by extension , each of us : " Do not imitate what is bad . " - 3 John 11 .
entries.dua: Yohane a kwalisane ̱ Gayo , nde seto ̱ buka te ̱ mo ̱ , nde na biso ̱ pe ̱ ná : " O s 'embilane ̱ nje ye bobe . " - 3 Yohane 11 .

entries.en: John warmly addressed Gaius as " the beloved , whom I truly love . "
entries.dua: Yohane a bele ̱ Gayo ná " ńa ndolo ńena na to ̱ ndino ̱ na mbale ̱ . "

entries.en: John was so shocked by the priest 's behavior that he told the priest , " I will never set foot in a Catholic church again . "
entries.dua: Yohane a ta mańaka jita na nje pata e bolino ̱ , a langwea mo ̱ ná , " Na si me ̱ nde ̱ pe ̱ te ̱ se ̱ mwende o ebas 'a Katolik to ̱ buńa . "

entries.en: John wrote : " By this the love of God was revealed in our case , that God sent his only - begotten Son into the world so that we might gain life through him . "
entries.dua: Yohane a tili ná : " Ndol 'a Loba e bīsabe ̱ nde biso ̱ ninka ná Loba a lom mpo ̱ m mao ma Muna o wase , ná ońol 'ao di be ̱ longe ̱ . "

entries.en: John wrote : " Little children , we should love , not in word or with the tongue , but in deed and truth . "
entries.dua: Yohane a tili ná : " A bana , di si to ̱ ndo ̱ na byala to ̱ na bepopo , nde na bebolo na mbale ̱ . "

entries.en: John Wycliffe and others desired to make God 's Word available to everyone .
entries.dua: Jo ̱ n Wiklif na bape ̱ pe ̱ ba ta ba pula ná moto te ̱ a we ̱ le ̱ langa Eyal 'a Loba .

entries.en: Jonathan is one of those friends who may come to mind .
entries.dua: Yonatan e nde diwo ̱ la ma mako ̱ m jeno ̱ ná di pomane ̱ o jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: Joseph 's loyalty gave him the opportunity to see Jehovah 's hand in correcting the injustices and in blessing him and his family .
entries.dua: Tingame ̱ la Yose ̱ f di boli mo ̱ epolo o je ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ ni Yehova a po ̱ ngulane ̱ no ̱ si te ̱ me ̱ la sim , a namse ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ na mbia mao .

entries.en: Joseph , a faithful servant of Jehovah , experienced injustice , not only at the hands of outsiders but also , more painfully , at the hands of his fleshly brothers .
entries.dua: Si te ̱ me ̱ la sim di kweledi Yose ̱ f muboled 'a Yehova ńa jemea , seto ̱ buka te ̱ o mā ma be ̱ n ba bato , nde bwambwam o mā ma bonasango 'ao b 'eyobo .

entries.en: Joseph , however , is called " a good and righteous man . "
entries.dua: Nde Yose ̱ f a belabe ̱ ná " mot 'a bwam na nu te ̱ m na sim . "

entries.en: Joseph , Rahab , Jesus , and the apostles displayed an inner strength that motivated them to perform good works .
entries.dua: Yose ̱ f , Rahab , Yesu , na bamuloloma ba ta ba be ̱ ne ̱ ngińa ni tute ̱ le ̱ babo ̱ o bola ebol 'a bwam .

entries.en: Joseph , though , was a disciple , but he could not bring himself to say so openly .
entries.dua: Nde Yose ̱ f mo ̱ a ta mokwedi , a si wusa nde puse ̱ le ̱ nika ná bwē .

entries.en: Joseph also stated that he was not guilty of the crime for which he was imprisoned .
entries.dua: Yose ̱ f a kwali pe ̱ ná mā mao ma sangi o njo ̱ m ba numno ̱ mo ̱ ńena ńalane ̱ mo ̱ o beboa .

entries.en: Joseph did not exactly disown Jesus , but neither did he have the courage to acknowledge him .
entries.dua: 10 : 32 , 33 ) Yose ̱ f a si to ̱ bi na bwē ná a bi Yesu , nde a si kusi pe ̱ to ̱ ngiń 'a mulema o jemba mo ̱ o mpoma .

entries.en: Joseph explained that the cupbearer would be restored to his former position in Pharaoh 's court .

entries.en: Or we may be able to give practical support to brothers and sisters who move to areas within the country , or even abroad , to serve where the need for Kingdom publishers is greater .
entries.dua: To ̱ so ̱ je ná di bola bonasango na bonańango ba male ̱ te ̱ dikalo owe ̱ ni ńo ̱ ng 'a bate ̱ dikalo ńeno ̱ jita oteten ekombo asu to ̱ so ̱ o ekombo epe ̱ pe ̱ nje e mapule ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: Or we may be struggling with feelings of inadequacy , with unfulfilled expectations , or with personal failings .
entries.dua: To ̱ so ̱ ná je o janane ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la si be ̱ la ńai ni dongame ̱ n , na dipita di makiṅakiṅane ̱ , to ̱ so ̱ be ̱ la ńai ni si matongwe ̱ le ̱ mambo mao .

entries.en: Or we may have already made progress , but when we examine ourselves further , we find that we can still improve our spirituality .
entries.dua: To ̱ so ̱ ná di ńaki yen ebe , nde niponda di wase ̱ le ̱ no ̱ biso ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ bwambwam , di so ̱ i ná jangame ̱ n pe ̱ te ̱ bata ńaka o mbad 'a mudī .

entries.en: Or we might explain things in such a way that only we get the credit for ideas or accomplishments that others also contributed to .
entries.dua: To ̱ so ̱ je ná di tele ̱ ye ̱ mambo mbadi ni mawaneye ̱ biso ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ edube , e be ̱ nde biana bane ̱ bonasango ba si boli labu jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ to ̱ we ̱ le ̱ dia ná di lambo di bolabe ̱ .

entries.en: Or were these individuals simply unaware of all the facts , or were they caught off guard ?
entries.dua: Nga si bia nde e , to ̱ so ̱ ná mambo ma bamban nde babo ̱ e ?

entries.en: Or what about the governments that promote war and ethnic violence , that oppress the poor and defenseless , that thrive on bribery and favoritism ?
entries.dua: Manea ma mawo ̱ ndo ̱ n ma mabota bila ekombo te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ yene ̱ , tumba te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ dine ̱ na tuse ̱ ńatue na nu si be ̱ n ngińa o lingea mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: Or what if you lose your job , and you are having difficulty finding another ?
entries.dua: Di kwale pe ̱ so ̱ ná nje yete ̱ na o bo ̱ lo ̱ ne ̱ ebol 'ango ̱ , nde e si be ̱ wa bu o kusa epe ̱ pe ̱ e ?

entries.en: Or what should you do if invited to play online games with strangers ?
entries.dua: To ̱ so ̱ nje o me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ bola ke ̱ o belabe ̱ o joka loko la video o inte ̱ rne ̱ t na bato o si bino ̱ e ?

entries.en: Or will we follow the Bible 's wise advice to settle matters quickly ?

entries.en: Or you may be grieving over the loss of a child .

entries.en: Or you might feel that reporting his sinful conduct to the elders , who could help him spiritually , would be a betrayal of your friendship .

entries.en: Other possible causes may be loneliness or the feeling that other Christian youths are doing better spiritually .

entries.en: Other scriptures that many have found comforting are Psalm 20 : 1 , 2 ; 31 : 7 ; 38 : 8 , 9 , 15 ; 55 : 22 ; 121 : 1 , 2 ; Isaiah 57 : 15 ; 66 : 13 ; Philippians 4 : 13 ; and 1 Peter 5 : 7 .

entries.en: Others , although well along in years themselves , are caring for elderly relatives .

entries.en: Others argue that true free will is only possible if we have absolute freedom .

entries.en: Others enjoyed a measure of success in this system of things but felt that something was missing in their life .

entries.en: Others have used material from our publications or our jw.org logo in advertisements , on products offered for sale , and in mobile device apps .

entries.en: Others may be devastated by the recent breakup of their marriage .

entries.en: Others may not have said these exact words , but they still made a vow before God .

entries.en: Others may note the wisdom , or good sense , in our actions .

entries.en: Others worry about losing control , convinced that younger ones cannot do things as well .

entries.en: Otherwise , he will cry out to Jehovah against you , and you will be guilty of sin . "

entries.en: Otherwise , they may be drawn to unbelieving relatives or compatriots who can relate to their culture and experiences .

entries.en: Our abilities are not the important thing .

entries.en: Our actions thereby prove our sincerity and give Jehovah something to bless .

entries.en: Our all - wise , all - powerful God , the one who controls the hail and the snow , can help you to surmount any obstacles that you encounter .

entries.en: Our attitude comes into the picture as we strive to increase the extent to which we let our light shine .

entries.en: Our awareness of this undeniable truth will prompt us to be humble , to recognize our limitations , and to adjust our view of the matter .
entries.dua: ( 1 Sam . 16 : 7 ) Bia lasu la nin mbale ̱ moto a titino ̱ ná a banga , di me ̱ nde ̱ tute ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ o sibise ̱ ńolo , o jemba myoyo masu , na o po ̱ ngulane ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ lasu la mambo .

entries.en: Our baptism shows that " we belong to Jehovah . "

entries.en: Our brothers , even those who are in poor economic situations , are like the Macedonians who were in " deep poverty " and yet begged for the privilege to give and did so generously . - 2 Cor .

entries.en: Our Christlike thinking will influence our speech , our conduct at work or in school , and the decisions we make each day .

entries.en: Our confidence in him will be strengthened when we keep in mind that he can " do more than superabundantly beyond all the things we ask or conceive . " - Eph .

entries.en: Paul addressed his letter to the " brothers " in Rome . That clearly included sisters , several of whom he mentioned by name .

entries.en: Paul advised Timothy : " A slave of the Lord does not need to fight , but needs to be gentle toward all , qualified to teach , showing restraint when wronged , instructing with mildness those not favorably disposed . "
entries.dua: Paulo a boli Timoteo malea ná : " Mūt 'a Sango a s 'angame ̱ n tanga mutango , a be ̱ nde muyao na be ̱ se ̱ , a bie lee ̱ na tuna ńolo , ome ̱ le ̱ bate ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ na yō ̱ . "

entries.en: Paul also alerted fellow Christians about dangers that could deprive them of the prize .

entries.en: Paul also discussed dangers that exist down to this day and that can deprive us of the prize .

entries.en: Paul counseled Hebrew Christians : " Strengthen the hands that hang down and the feeble knees , and keep making straight paths for your feet , so that what is lame may not be put out of joint but , rather , may be healed . "

entries.en: Paul described how people living in the last days would relate to one another .

entries.en: Paul describes it as " the spirit that is now at work in the sons of disobedience . "

entries.en: Paul did not boast over his accomplishments before becoming a Christian ; nor did he describe his physical appearance .

entries.en: Paul did not embarrass others or pressure them into taking a desired course of action .

entries.en: Paul directed his fellow believers to the Source of true freedom .

entries.en: Paul encourages us to be spiritual people .

entries.en: Paul exhorted all Christians to speak " what is good for building up as the need may be , to impart what is beneficial " to others .
entries.dua: Paulo ome ̱ le ̱ Kriste ̱ n ye ̱ se ̱ ná , eyala e mabuse ̱ babo ̱ o mudumbu e be ̱ nde " eyal 'a bwam ońola longisane ̱ , kaponda yeno ̱ ná e pulabe ̱ ná e waneye ba ba masenge ̱ muse ̱ ṅ . " ( Efe .

entries.en: Paul exhorted Timothy : " Flee from youthful desires , but pursue righteousness , faith , love , peace . " - 2 Tim .

entries.en: Paul exhorted Timothy : " Train yourself with godly devotion as your aim . "

entries.en: Paul exhorts us : " Become imitators of God , as beloved children , and go on walking in love , just as the Christ also loved us and gave himself for us . "

entries.en: Paul four times says that " some of them " disobeyed .

entries.en: Paul further stated : " I am saying this so that no one may delude you with persuasive arguments .

entries.en: Paul got the point . He concluded : " When I am weak , then I am powerful . "

entries.en: Paul greeted Prisca and Aquila , " to whom not only I but also all the congregations of the nations give thanks . "

entries.en: Paul had experienced extreme difficulties ; yet , he demonstrated that he had " the peace of God . "
entries.dua: Paulo a lembe ̱ mitakisan minde ̱ ne ̱ ; nde a lee ̱ le ̱ ná a ta a be ̱ ne ̱ " musango ma Loba . "

entries.en: Paul had taken time to teach Timothy his " methods in connection with Christ . "
entries.dua: Paulo a no ̱ ngi ponda o lee ̱ Timoteo " bedangwedi [ bao ] o Kristo . "

entries.en: Paul had written to the Corinthians : " I am sending Timothy to you , because he is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord . He will remind you of my methods in connection with Christ Jesus , just as I am teaching everywhere in every congregation . "
entries.dua: Paulo a tiledi bato ba Korinto ná : " Na lomedi bińo ̱ Timoteo ńena ńe mun 'am ńa ndolo na ńa mbale ̱ o Sango ; mo ̱ a me ̱ nde ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ bińo ̱ bedangwedi bam o Kristo , kana a malee ̱ no ̱ wuma ye ̱ se ̱ o myemba te ̱ . " ( 1 Kor .

entries.en: Paul here describes what Jehovah does , not before , but during trials .
entries.dua: Owan Paulo e nde o kwalea nje Loba a mabolano ̱ , seto ̱ oboso ná makekisan ma mapo ̱ , nde o ponda makekisan .

entries.en: Paul introduces his list of ungodly qualities with the words " for men will be . . . "

entries.en: Paul learned through experience that sacrificing oneself in behalf of others brings not only personal satisfaction but also - and more important - Jehovah 's blessing and approval . - Acts 20 : 24 , 35 .
entries.dua: ( 2 Kor . 12 : 15 ) Dibie ̱ la longe ̱ Paulo a tano ̱ a mábe ̱ ne ̱ di boli mo ̱ so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná , bola la wame ̱ ne ̱ ka jabea ońola bwam ba bane ̱ di malenea wa mutam - nde di buki me ̱ se ̱ - o mado ̱ lisane ̱ Yehova , o kusane ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ minam . - Bebolo 20 : 24 , 35 .

entries.en: Paul likens God 's Word to a sword that Jehovah has given us .
entries.dua: Paulo mo ̱ ná Eyal 'a Loba ye nde ka po ̱ Yehova a bolino ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: Paul lists other negative qualities that show that people lack love for one another .
entries.dua: Paulo a to ̱ pedi ońola bene ̱ bede ̱ mo ba bobe be malee ̱ ná bato ba si be ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ ndolo .

entries.en: Paul made major changes after his baptism , but notoriety followed him .
entries.dua: Paulo a tuko jita ombusa dubisabe ̱ lao . Nde bato ba si dimbedi njika moto a se ̱ le ̱ no ̱ be ̱ .

entries.en: Paul mentioned one way when he wrote to fellow believers : " Continue putting up with one another and forgiving one another freely even if anyone has a cause for complaint against another .
entries.dua: Paulo a to ̱ pi ońola mbadi po ̱ ńa bola nika ponda a tiledino ̱ bonasango ná : " We ̱ lisane ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ , lakisane ̱ pe ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ mawuse ̱ , yete ̱ na mō ̱ a be ̱ nedi nupe ̱ pe ̱ njo ̱ m . "

entries.en: Paul mentioned that same truth when he said : " Each person will receive his own reward according to his own work . "
entries.dua: Paulo a lango mu mulemlem ma mbale ̱ ponda a kwalino ̱ ná : " Moto te ̱ a me ̱ nde ̱ kusa mao musawedi kapond 'ebol 'ao . "

entries.en: Paul realized that there was only so much he could do without help from a higher source .
entries.dua: Paulo a so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná mambo mō ̱ me mena a titino ̱ ná a bola esibe ̱ jongwane ̱ la ngińa ni buki ńao .

entries.en: Paul recognized that widespread , selfish love would pose dangers for Christians .
entries.dua: Paulo embi ná to ̱ ndo ̱ la moto mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ lena di lań o wase di me ̱ nde ̱ nde be ̱ Kriste ̱ n lambi .

entries.en: Paul reminded the Philippians : " You know the proof [ Timothy ] gave of himself , that like a child with a father he slaved with me to advance the good news . "

entries.en: Paul sent greetings to many fellow Christians .

entries.en: Paul was , in effect , saying that " the peace of God " is more wonderful than can be imagined .

entries.en: Still , holding faithfully to Christ 's teachings would be challenging if one 's close friends or family members rejected the truth .

entries.en: Still , how would you respond if asked for evidence that resurrection promises are valid many years or even centuries after they were made ?

entries.en: Still , I was always looking over my shoulder , waiting for the consequences of my actions .

entries.en: Still , if you are ever tempted to break one of Jehovah 's laws , strengthen yourself by taking time to ponder the disastrous spiritual consequences that you could face for failing to restrain sinful impulses .

entries.en: Still , it is possible to clothe ourselves with humility .

entries.en: They have truly made me feel Jehovah 's loving arms around me . "
entries.dua: Ba boli mba na so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná mā ma Yehova ma dinge ̱ le ̱ mba . "

entries.en: They help us to understand that our ability to bear fruit does not depend on the response of the people in our territory .
entries.dua: Mi mongwane ̱ biso ̱ o so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná ya lasu la bepuma di si se ̱ medi o ne ̱ ni bato ba makasano ̱ mwe ̱ ndi masu .

entries.en: They included Eduard Varter , an exile who had been baptized in Germany in 1924 .
entries.dua: O muso ̱ ngi mabu , o ta o be ̱ ne ̱ Eduard Varte ̱ r , ńamukoma mō ̱ nu dubisabe ̱ o Jaman o mbu 1924 .

entries.en: They invite me in , and often I can study the Bible with them .
entries.dua: Ba bele ̱ mba o mamboa mabu , na mba na botea jokwa na babo ̱ .

entries.en: They kept a positive attitude by recalling that , like Israel 's trek in the wilderness , their stay in the camp would eventually come to an end . - 2 Cor .
entries.dua: Jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la ne ̱ ni Bonaisrael ba dangono ̱ o eyaṅ longwane ̱ babo ̱ ná ba si sunjume ̱ ye ̱ , to ̱ dimbea ná bejedi babu o ni yala be me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ o su . - 2 Kor .

entries.en: They kept doing God 's will .
entries.dua: Ba tiki londise ̱ jemea la Loba .

entries.en: They know that true and lasting security comes to those who demonstrate trust in God by living in harmony with Bible principles . - Ps .
entries.dua: I bi ná ba bena ba malakisane ̱ Loba tongwea na die ̱ le ̱ longe ̱ labu mulatako na bete ̱ sedi ba Bibe ̱ l , nde ba me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ betatedi ba mbale ̱ na ba bwindea . - Mye .

entries.en: They learn that freedom has boundaries and that decisions and conduct have consequences - good or bad .
entries.dua: Ba mokwa ná wonja e be ̱ n myoyo , na ná lambo te ̱ di mabolano ̱ o longe ̱ le ná di lenea biso ̱ mbeu a ńolo to ̱ tombwane ̱ .

entries.en: They left a land that was familiar to them in order to move to a place most of them had never seen .
entries.dua: ( Esr 1 : 2 , 3 , 5 ) Ba dī ekombo yena ba tano ̱ ba máko ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ o wala o ekombo yena jita labu ba si tano ̱ ba bia .

entries.en: They lived in a violent and immoral world .
entries.dua: Ba ta nde o wase ni ta ni londa na njo na musonje .

entries.en: They look forward to gaining the prize of everlasting life on earth - and what a happy prospect that is ! - 2 Pet .
entries.dua: Mi be ̱ n dipita la be ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ la bwindea o wase - a se ̱ dipita la bonam to ̱ ne ̱ ! ! - 2 Pet .

entries.en: They look forward to serving with Jesus Christ in his heavenly Kingdom and sharing with him in bringing mankind to perfection .
entries.dua: 3 : 14 ) I be ̱ n dipita la bolea mwemba na Yesu Kristo o Janea lao la mo ̱ ń , na o po ̱ le ̱ mbel 'a moto o ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ mwemba na mo ̱ . ( Bbī .

entries.en: They look to God to solve injustice and the other problems we face . "
entries.dua: Ba pite ̱ ná Loba a me ̱ nde ̱ bo ̱ le ̱ si te ̱ me ̱ la sim na mine ̱ mitakisan di be ̱ nno ̱ . "

entries.en: They may conclude , ' As long as my child is not baptized , he cannot be disfellowshipped . '
entries.dua: 22 : 15 ) Jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la ba bayedi le nde ná , ' Etum te ̱ mun 'abu a si dubisabe ̱ no ̱ , a titi ná a pangabe ̱ . '

entries.en: They may even fear for our eternal welfare .
entries.dua: Be pe ̱ ná ba bwa bo ̱ ngo ̱ ná Loba e ná a ko ̱ kise ̱ biso ̱ ombusa kwedi .

entries.en: They may even respond unkindly because of our lack of confidence .
entries.dua: Be ná ba banga sengane ̱ biso ̱ ońola si be ̱ ne ̱ lasu la mbaki .

entries.en: They may have been raised in the truth .
entries.dua: Yen ebe ba kokedi nde o mbale ̱ .

entries.en: They may induce enemy soldiers to fight among themselves or fool them into isolating themselves from the main fighting force .
entries.dua: Ba mabola bate ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ babo ̱ banane ̱ le ̱ mō ̱ na nune ̱ , to ̱ so ̱ ba lemse ̱ babo ̱ ná ba pande na badie ̱ le ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: They may not have examined the question of God 's existence carefully , but they are drawn to the idea of being free to do as they please .
entries.dua: Ba ba makwale ̱ nika be nde bato bena ba si no ̱ ngi ponda o dutea nga Loba e to ̱ ke ̱ m , na bena ba malo ̱ ndo ̱ be ̱ na jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la be ̱ wonja o bola nje ba to ̱ ndino ̱ .

entries.en: They may think that we no longer love them because we do not celebrate holidays with them .
entries.dua: Be ná bo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná di si to ̱ ndi pe ̱ babo ̱ ońolana di si mukea pe ̱ na babo ̱ o ngando i si do ̱ lisan Loba .

entries.en: They may use such propaganda as : " You cannot trust your leaders ! "
entries.dua: Be ná ba kwala ná : " O titina o lakisane ̱ banedi bo ̱ ngo ̱ ! "

entries.en: They meticulously obeyed some of its smallest details , for Jesus acknowledged : " You give the tenth of the mint and the dill and the cumin . "
entries.dua: Mambo ma sadisadi nde ba tano ̱ bombwea ná pe ̱ ńe ̱ pe ̱ ńe ̱ , Yesu embi nika , a kwala ná : " Lo mabola dongo diwo ̱ la dom la sisaṅ na pe ̱ be ̱ na ndongo njangi . "

entries.en: They must always make sure that what they teach is solidly based on God 's Word .
entries.dua: ( Yak . 3 : 1 ) Bangame ̱ n so ̱ no ̱ ngo ̱ jangame ̱ ye ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ ná nje ba malee ̱ no ̱ e sikime ̱ ye ̱ nde o Eyal 'a Loba .

entries.en: They must monitor the help given by companions and continue to teach their children themselves .
entries.dua: Bangame ̱ n jombwea di jongwane ̱ di mawe ̱ na bane ̱ bonasango , na benga pe ̱ jokwe ̱ le ̱ bana babu .

entries.en: They must recognize that Jehovah God has the ultimate authority to impose what he determines to be just , necessary , and reasonable limits .
entries.dua: Bangame ̱ n o jemba ná Yehova Loba nde a be ̱ n doi la byanedi lasam o domse ̱ njika myoyo mena mi te ̱ m na sim , mi mapule ̱ , na mangame ̱ n .

entries.en: They must work hard to fulfill this obligation .
entries.dua: 5 : 8 ) Bangame ̱ n o bola ebolo na ngińa o bwam ba londise ̱ mu m 'bē ̱ .

entries.en: They need a chance to hear the good news . "
entries.dua: Ba be ̱ n ńo ̱ ngi o senga myango ma bwam . "

entries.en: They need to see that we care about them .
entries.dua: Bangame ̱ n o je ̱ ne ̱ ná di mombwea babo ̱ .

entries.en: They need to sense Jehovah 's love and compassion among their fellow Christians .
entries.dua: Ba be ̱ n ńo ̱ ngi o senga ndolo na nded 'a Yehova ke ̱ be na bonasango .

entries.en: They needed insight , the ability to look beyond the obvious and to see into a matter .
entries.dua: E ta so ̱ e pula ná ba be ̱ ye ̱ ne ̱ ná ba s 'ombwea byombwedi ba miso ̱ , nde ba so ̱ le o njiba , ná ba so ̱ ṅtane ̱ njo ̱ m ni wan kwed 'a moto .

entries.en: They notice our neat attire , polite behavior , and warm smile .
entries.dua: Ba me ̱ ne ̱ bebo ̱ tedi basu ba bwam , k 'asu ńe ede ̱ mo na muyao , na lo ̱ lasu la bokenju .

entries.en: They often thank us for visiting them .
entries.dua: Ngedi iwo ̱ , ba matimbise ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ masoma ná di po ̱ i pe ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: They opened their homes to us .
entries.dua: Ba tele ̱ ye ̱ biso ̱ milongi mabu .

entries.en: They overstepped proper bounds and did not respect their fellow Christians ' responsibility to make their own decisions .
entries.dua: Ba ta ba kata myoyo mabu ba si be ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ edube ońola m 'bē ̱ bonasango abu o dube ̱ ba be ̱ nno ̱ o no ̱ ngo ̱ bedomsedi babu ba babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: They participate in a preaching campaign to reach as many remote homes as possible while the weather is favorable .
entries.dua: Be o sambane ̱ dikalo o bwam ba kwalisane ̱ baje ̱ ombusa mi midongo niponda ngo ̱ e sibino ̱ .

entries.en: They place religious and political leaders , sports figures , entertainment stars , and other celebrities on pedestals , often considering them to be almost superhuman .
entries.dua: Ba mabwe ̱ le ̱ nate ̱ na o mo ̱ ń badiedi ba bebasi na ba politik , boke ̱ bo ̱ l bande ̱ ne ̱ na bane ̱ batune ̱ ńolo , bato ba busi mina o sinima to ̱ o musiki , na bato ba mina bape ̱ pe ̱ , ba langa na babo ̱ ngedi iwo ̱ ka bewekedi basam .

entries.en: They proceeded to the convention city , convinced that Jehovah had answered their desperate prayers for help .
entries.dua: Ba tongwe ̱ le ̱ o jukea o jako ̱ to ̱ ne ̱ , na nin mbaki ná Yehova alabe ̱ muka mabu ná ongwane ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: They read to us the book From Paradise Lost to Paradise Regained .
entries.dua: Ba ta nde bokwe ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ tongwea na kalati Du paradis perdu au paradis reconquis .

entries.en: They realize that Jehovah has yoked them together and that he wants them to " stick " to each other .
entries.dua: Ba bi ná Yehova a lati babo ̱ , a mapula pe ̱ ná ba " tingame ̱ " mō ̱ na nune ̱ .

entries.en: They realize the seriousness of humbly living up to their solemn vow for as long as they remain in special full - time service .
entries.dua: Ba maso ̱ ṅtane ̱ mweńa ma londise ̱ kakane ̱ labu na sibise ̱ la ńolo etum te ̱ beno ̱ o ebol 'a pond 'a mususu ya tobotobo .

entries.en: They recall that when the Pioneer Service School began in 1977 , the emphasis was placed on being willing to move and serve where the need was greater .
entries.dua: Ba dia ba mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná , ponda esukul 'a paonia e botedino ̱ o mbu 1977 , ba ta be ̱ ba tute ̱ le ̱ bautu o wala bolea we ̱ ni ńo ̱ ngi ńeno ̱ bonde ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: They rejected Jehovah as their Father and estranged themselves from the security of his protective rule . - Gen .
entries.dua: Ba caki Yehova Sango abu , ba pandise ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ na betatedi be mawe ̱ na mambenda mao . - Bbo .

entries.en: They rejected the guidance God had provided .
entries.dua: Ba bangi bupe ̱ bediedi Loba a bolino ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: They rejoice in your name all day long , and in your righteousness they are exalted . " - Ps .
entries.dua: Ba mabwane ̱ dina lo ̱ ngo ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ , be pe ̱ mutam ońola te ̱ me ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ la sim . " - Mye .

entries.en: They remained there until Herod died .
entries.dua: Ba jai oten natē ̱ kwed 'a Herode .

entries.en: They said : " We are witnesses of all the things he did . "
entries.dua: Ba kwali ná : " Biso ̱ je mboṅ a me ̱ se ̱ a bolino ̱ . "

entries.en: They said that it would be a shame if they had no Witness children in their school .
entries.dua: Ba kwali ná ba si be ̱ ne ̱ te ̱ mūtu to ̱ mō ̱ ńe Mboṅ a Yehova o esukulu abu nika e wusa be ̱ babo ̱ iso ̱ n .

entries.en: They saw him as a political and religious rival who threatened their position .
entries.dua: Ba bo bo ̱ ngo ̱ ná bato ba me ̱ nde ̱ sengane ̱ mo ̱ , ba si sue ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: They say , " To help humble people learn about Jehovah is a joy beyond compare ! "
entries.dua: Bā ná , " Jongwane ̱ la ba mulema musibi o bia Yehova le nde muńe ̱ nge ̱ mu si be ̱ n elangisan ! "

entries.en: They searched everywhere , even in the cows ' feed .
entries.dua: Ba wasi bepolo be ̱ se ̱ nate ̱ na o ndabo a mada ńa ńaka .

entries.en: They sent two of their number , Peter and John , to pray for the new believers to receive holy spirit .
entries.dua: Na mo ̱ di loma Petro na Yohane o kane ̱ ońola yi Kriste ̱ n a peńa ná i kuse mudī - musangi .

entries.en: They should avoid becoming involved in political issues , no matter how right or just a certain cause might seem .
entries.dua: Yesu a die ̱ le ̱ so ̱ biso ̱ eyembilan , ná di si so ̱ lo ̱ o bekwali ba politik , e be ̱ ná lambo di te ̱ m to ̱ di si te ̱ m .

entries.en: They should be quick to obey .
entries.dua: Bangame ̱ n nde be ̱ makwasi o sengane ̱ .

entries.en: They should be ready to adjust their thinking and decisions when appropriate , and all of us do well to follow that example .
entries.dua: Bangame ̱ ne ̱ o be ̱ be ̱ be ̱ o wengisane ̱ mbad 'abu ńa je ̱ ne ̱ mambo na bedomsedi babu yete ̱ na nika ńangame ̱ n , nde biso ̱ be ̱ se ̱ pe ̱ di mabola bwam o bupe ̱ y 'eyembilan .

entries.en: They should make their decision as a couple interested in pleasing God and maintaining a clean conscience before him . - Compare 1 Timothy 1 : 18 , 19 ; 2 Timothy 1 : 3 .
entries.dua: 6 : 4 , 5 ) Be bedomsedi be nde babu . Ba no ̱ nge bedomsedi ka mome na muto ba be ̱ n ńo ̱ ngi o do ̱ lisane ̱ Loba , na be ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ doi la mulema di sangi oboso bao . - Kobisane ̱ 1 Timoteo 1 : 18 , 19 ; 2 Timoteo 1 : 3 .

entries.en: They showed hatred for Wycliffe , his Bible , and his followers .
entries.dua: Ba botedi singe ̱ Wiklif , Bibe ̱ l ao nikame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na bokwedi bao .

entries.en: They spent the dark , cold night in a room on the second floor of their battered home .
entries.dua: Ba tombise ̱ nde bulu o nde ̱ ki nilonde ̱ iba ńa ndabo abu ni buledi oteten a mulo ̱ lo ̱ ko ̱ munde ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: They start praying , often battling to speak at first , but every time , within a few sentences , their voice gets stronger and they say the most heartfelt prayer .
entries.dua: O bebotedi , byala be si ta be we ̱ le ̱ busa , nde son na son ba we ̱ li pase ̱ le ̱ byala , nde o su la ponda , doi lembame ̱ , na babo ̱ ba bīse ̱ Yehova njib 'a mulema mabu .

entries.en: They supplicated Jehovah in prayer to give them the power needed to endure .
entries.dua: Ba so ̱ so ̱ me ̱ ye ̱ Yehova o muka ná a bole babo ̱ ngińa ni ta ni pula babo ̱ ná ba be ̱ titimbe ̱ .

entries.en: They take their place near a bus stop and offer our Bible literature to passersby .
entries.dua: Ba maja be ̱ be ̱ na wum 'a ndiyo o bola batombe ̱ ngea kalati .

entries.en: They then took me to the camp infirmary to confirm that my bones were not broken and dragged me back to my tent .
entries.dua: Na babo ̱ balane ̱ mba o do ̱ kita o be ̱ mbaki ná na si kusi ebue ̱ le ̱ to ̱ ewo ̱ , na babo ̱ bo ̱ ngo ̱ mba nate ̱ na o muno ̱ ko ̱ mam .

entries.en: They then volunteered to help with the construction of world headquarters in Warwick , New York .
entries.dua: Ombusa nika , bongwane ̱ o longa mulopo m 'ebolo o Warwik , Ńu York .

entries.en: They think that they do not have time to train others .
entries.dua: Ba mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná ba si be ̱ n ponda o longa bape ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: They thus became examples of righteousness , and they led truly successful lives .
entries.dua: Ba timbi so ̱ byembilan ba te ̱ me ̱ la sim , ba tongwe ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ o die ̱ le ̱ malonge ̱ mabu o mbad 'a bwam . ( Mye .

entries.en: They told him : " Believe in the Lord Jesus , and you will get saved . " - Acts 16 : 25 - 34 .
entries.dua: Na babo ̱ ba kwalane ̱ mo ̱ ná : " Dube ̱ Sango Yesu Kristo , nde o me ̱ nde ̱ jongisabe ̱ . " - Bebolo 16 : 25 - 34 .

entries.en: They took a zealous lead in the preaching work .
entries.dua: Ba ta nde bate ̱ dikalo ba ko ̱ di .

entries.en: They traveled the islands by boat and bicycle , and they well remember their first cycling trip - about 20 miles ( 32 km ) over steep hills , under the blazing sun .
entries.dua: Ba po ̱ i nde na medi ma munja , nde ba ta pe ̱ ba bolane ̱ medi ma mundi o yenga o be byondi be ̱ se ̱ ; nika ńo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ babo ̱ nged 'a boso ba duane ̱ no ̱ medi o bwaba ba lo ̱ ndo ̱ ba lambo ka 32 Km o midongo na owas 'a wei a ngińa .

entries.en: They traveled to Bethlehem despite the fact that Mary was soon to give birth to her first child .
entries.dua: Balo o Betlehem , to ̱ ná Maria a tano ̱ be ̱ be ̱ o ya mun 'ao ńaboso .

entries.en: They trust that like the father in the parable of the prodigal son , Jehovah is ever on the lookout to welcome back sinners who repent .
entries.dua: Ba lakisane ̱ ná ka nu sango a muna ńa munia ma muna nu pimbedi , Yehova a le ̱ le ̱ m o kasa nuwusi ńena ńate ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: They trusted in the promise found at Psalm 37 : 5 : " Commit your way to Jehovah ; rely on him , and he will act in your behalf . "
entries.dua: Ba ta ba lakisane ̱ kakane ̱ di nanga o Myenge 37 : 5 : " Bake ̱ Yehova mangea mo ̱ ngo ̱ , pite ̱ pe ̱ na mo ̱ , nde mo ̱ a me ̱ nde ̱ yue ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ . "

entries.en: They turned away from Jehovah and worshipped false gods .
entries.dua: Bumbe ̱ le ̱ Yehova mbusa na jowe ̱ pe ̱ maloba ma lobango .

entries.en: They understand that being generous is a way to gain " true " riches .
entries.dua: Ba maso ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná be ̱ la muyao le nde mbad 'a tombwane ̱ m 'bwaṅ ma " mbale ̱ " .

entries.en: They urged him and his family to flee from the doomed cities .
entries.dua: Na babo ̱ ba langwea mo ̱ na mbia mao ná ba ńe mi mindi mi me ̱ nde ̱ ńamsabe ̱ mīla .

entries.en: They usually promise that they will love , cherish , and respect each other and that they will do so " for as long as [ they ] both shall live together on earth according to God 's marital arrangement . "
entries.dua: Ba yo ̱ ki nde o bolane ̱ le ̱ kakane ̱ la to ̱ ndo ̱ ne ̱ le ̱ , bongwane ̱ le ̱ , na bolane ̱ le ̱ edube ; na ná ba me ̱ nde ̱ bola nika " etum te ̱ [ babo ̱ ] babane ̱ ba me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ be ̱ longe ̱ o wase bupisane ̱ bete ̱ sedi ba Loba ba diba . "

entries.en: They view themselves as Jehovah 's Witnesses .
entries.dua: Be me ̱ ne ̱ nde babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ ka Mboṅ a Yehova .

entries.en: They want to cultivate in their child from infancy a heartfelt appreciation for Jehovah 's elevated moral standards .
entries.dua: Ba mawe ̱ ná botea o mińa mao ma mūtu ba de ̱ mo ̱ o mulema ndol 'a bete ̱ sedi basam ba Yehova jombwea bedangwedi .

entries.en: They wanted me to make the military my career . I had no desire to stay in the military service , so after finishing my service time of two years , I was honorably discharged in 1956 .
entries.dua: Ba puli ná na be ̱ nde sonja o longe ̱ lam le ̱ se ̱ , nde na si ta na to ̱ ndo ̱ y 'ebolo , na sawono ̱ eto ̱ m am ya mbu miba , na timbisabe ̱ o mboa n 'edube o mbu 1956 .

entries.en: They wanted to keep the status quo . Many of their members enjoyed political power under the Roman administration .
entries.dua: Babo ̱ ba ta nde ba pula ná Bajū ba tike be ̱ owas 'a byanedi ba Roma ebanja nika e ta e bola babo ̱ doi na bepolo basam .

entries.en: They wanted to make sure I knew how serious my decision was .
entries.dua: Ba ta ba pula be ̱ mbaki ná na bi bodilo ba bedomsedi na tano ̱ na pula no ̱ ngo ̱ .

entries.en: They were even saying " shocking things " against Jehovah .
entries.dua: Ba ta nde ba bolane ̱ " byala ba dipama " te ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ Yehova .

entries.en: They were imperfect , and they faced many of the challenges we face , including some that were life threatening .
entries.dua: Ba si ta ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ , ba lembe ̱ pe ̱ mitakisan jita mena biso ̱ pe ̱ di malembe ̱ no ̱ we ̱ nge ̱ , na mō ̱ mena mi wusa bole ̱ ná ba bo ̱ lo ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ labu .

entries.en: They were not all of my age or from my cultural background .
entries.dua: Bō ̱ babu ba si ta ba mimbu mam , to ̱ be ̱ ne ̱ milemlem ma bede ̱ mo ba yabane ̱ .

entries.en: They were not at Matthew 's home simply to eat .
entries.dua: Ba si po ̱ i omboa Mateo o da buka te ̱ , ba ta nde ba bupe ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: They were not disappointed , for our God " gives power to the tired one . "
entries.dua: Ba si sambo , ońolana Loba lasu a " mabatea nuwo ̱ li ngińa . " ( Yes .

entries.en: They were obligated to read the Law daily , write a copy of it , and " observe all the words of this Law and these regulations by carrying them out . " - Read Deuteronomy 17 : 18 - 20 .
entries.dua: I ta eto ̱ m o langa Mbenda buńa te ̱ , o tombe ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ o kalati nipe ̱ pe ̱ , na " ne ̱ nge ̱ pe ̱ min myeka na bete ̱ sedi . " - Langa Ndimbisedi 17 : 18 - 20 .

entries.en: They were on their way to a convention at which Milan 's parents intended to get baptized .
entries.dua: Ba ta nde bala o jako ̱ to ̱ ne ̱ dinde ̱ ne ̱ owe ̱ ni bayedi ba Milan ba tano ̱ bangame ̱ n o dubisabe ̱ .

entries.en: They were rich , rewarding years , full of encouraging experiences .
entries.dua: Mi mimbu mi ta nde ma m 'bwaṅ , na minam , na mi londi na myango mi membe ̱ .

entries.en: They were suffering opposition and were subjected to abusive speech .
entries.dua: Nde mi myemba mi ta mi be ̱ ne ̱ ńo ̱ ng 'a jongwane ̱ na bediedi ebanja mi ta mi lembe ̱ mitakisan na dibena .

entries.en: They were supposed to unlock the meaning of God 's Word and help others to walk on the road to eternal life .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 11 : 52 ) Ba ta bangame ̱ n tele ̱ so ̱ ṅtane ̱ l 'Eyal 'a Loba , nika ná ba tele ̱ ye ̱ bape ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ , na jongwane ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ o dangwa o nge 'a longe ̱ la bwindea .
