entries.dua: Di ta pe ̱ jukea o ndongame ̱ n o mwemba ma Tokmok .

entries.en: We also benefit from God 's Word and his holy spirit when we prepare for and attend congregation meetings .
entries.dua: 5 : 17 ) Eyal 'a Loba na mudī mao musangi ba mawanea pe ̱ biso ̱ tombwane ̱ ke ̱ di maboṅsane ̱ ndongame ̱ n na jukea pe ̱ oten .

entries.en: We also contribute to peace when we approach government officials in a respectful way - including those who may oppose our work .
entries.dua: Di mabola pe ̱ ná musango mu be ̱ yete ̱ na di lee ̱ le ̱ edube ońola baboledi ba go ̱ bina - nikame ̱ ne ̱ pe ̱ na ba bena ba mate ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ ebol 'asu .

entries.en: We also derive great benefit from the spiritual instruction we receive .
entries.dua: Belēdi ba mudī di makusano ̱ oten be biso ̱ muse ̱ ṅ munde ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We also discreetly preached to other prisoners , some of whom later became Jehovah 's Witnesses .
entries.dua: Di te ̱ ye ̱ pe ̱ bane ̱ bato ba beboa dikalo o diwuta , bō ̱ babu ba timbi be ̱ Mboṅ a Yehova .

entries.en: We also do well to introduce scriptures in a way that engenders respect for the Bible .
entries.dua: E me ̱ nde ̱ pe ̱ be ̱ bwam ná di bie lee ̱ bepasi ba Bibe ̱ l ńai ni matute ̱ le ̱ moto o bola Bibe ̱ l edube .

entries.en: We also donate to support those caring for the work at world headquarters and at branch offices around the earth .
entries.dua: Di mabola pe ̱ mabea o sue ̱ le ̱ ba bena ba mabole ̱ ebolo o mulopo m 'ebolo na o mikanjo m 'ebolo ma wase ńe ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: We also had to collect water from a well .
entries.dua: Di ta pe ̱ nde di toa madiba o tongo ekukudu .

entries.en: We also helped to strengthen a small group of publishers in the nearby town of Kurganinsk .
entries.dua: Jongwane ̱ pe ̱ o jembe ̱ son a dibo ̱ to ̱ la bate ̱ dikalo o mbasan ma mundi ma Kurganinsk .

entries.en: We also increase our joy as we reflect on our current blessings , imitate the faith of others , and seek to do God 's will .
entries.dua: Je pe ̱ ná di kolise ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ masu ke ̱ di madutea jombwea minam di be ̱ nno ̱ we ̱ nge ̱ , di membilane ̱ dube ̱ la bape ̱ pe ̱ , di wasa pe ̱ bola jemea la Loba .

entries.en: We also invited local friends to join us for meals and excursions .
entries.dua: Di ta pe ̱ di bele ̱ mako ̱ m masu ma y 'ekombo o po ̱ da na biso ̱ na wala pe ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ mundi .

entries.en: We also know that love " does not brag , does not get puffed up . "
entries.dua: 3 : 12 ) Di bi pe ̱ ná ndolo " e si masese ̱ , e si malombitane ̱ . "

entries.en: We also learned that God lovingly provided the ransom sacrifice of his Son so that we might be freed from sin and death .
entries.dua: Joko pe ̱ ná ndolo e tute ̱ le ̱ Yehova o bola Mun 'ao ka diko ̱ ti ná di te ̱ me ̱ wonja na bobe na kwedi .

entries.en: We also need faith in Jehovah 's Word and in his way of doing things , trusting God 's inspired counsel .
entries.dua: E mapula pe ̱ ná di dube ̱ Eyal 'a Yehova na mbad 'ao ńa bola la mambo , na lakisane ̱ pe ̱ malea mao .

entries.en: We also need to approach the elders , who can offer us spiritual help .
entries.dua: ( 1 Yohane 1 : 9 ) E mapula pe ̱ ná je ̱ ne ̱ batudu , ná ba waneye biso ̱ jongwane ̱ la mudī .

entries.en: We also need to ask , ' Do I continue to be made new in my dominant mental attitude ? '
entries.dua: 5 : 19 - 21 ) E mapula pe ̱ ná di baise ̱ biso ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ ná : ' Mo ̱ , na mabenga timbisabe ̱ peńa o moto neno ̱ oteten am e ? '

entries.en: We also need to pray frequently for God 's spirit to help us fight any tendency of feeling superior to others . - Gal .
entries.dua: ( Yoh 13 : 12 - 17 ) Jangame ̱ n pe ̱ kane ̱ ponda na ponda te ̱ ná mudī musangi mongwane ̱ biso ̱ o janane ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná di buki bane ̱ . - Gal .

entries.en: We also pray to God that angels may direct us to find honesthearted ones .
entries.dua: Di makane ̱ pe ̱ Loba ná ange ̱ l ao i die ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ o so ̱ bamilema ma mbale ̱ be ̱ se ̱ . ( Mat .

entries.en: We also reached out to help others at our meetings .
entries.dua: Jongwane ̱ pe ̱ bape ̱ pe ̱ o ndongame ̱ n asu .

entries.en: We also read in the Scriptures : " Husbands should love their wives as their own bodies .
entries.dua: Bibe ̱ l e makwala pe ̱ ná : ' Bome bangame ̱ n to ̱ ndo ̱ bito babu ka mańolo mabu mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We also see that despite their failures , Jehovah did not give up on the Israelites .
entries.dua: Di so ̱ ṅtane ̱ pe ̱ ná Yehova a si com bana ba Israel to ̱ na mawuse ̱ mabu .

entries.en: We also share Jehovah 's view of life by cultivating a proper attitude toward safety .
entries.dua: Di malee ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ ná di me ̱ ne ̱ longe ̱ kana Yehova ke ̱ je ye ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We also shared regularly in the field ministry . "
entries.dua: Di ta pe ̱ di te ̱ dikalo ponda ye ̱ se ̱ . "

entries.en: We also treasure the gift of life and our ability to enjoy it .
entries.dua: Di matimbise ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ masoma ońolana je longe ̱ , di mabwane ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: We also walk in love when we are patient , kind , and forgiving .
entries.dua: 24 : 14 ; Lukas 10 : 27 ) Di madangwa pe ̱ o ndolo ke ̱ je we ̱ lisane ̱ , muyao , na be ̱ be ̱ o lakise ̱ .

entries.en: We are able to show unselfish love because God created us in his image .
entries.dua: Je nde ná di lee ̱ le ̱ ninka ndolo ońolana Loba a weki biso ̱ o bowan bao .

entries.en: We are also helped to develop lasting peace by means of a remarkable gift from our heavenly Father - his holy spirit . - Acts 9 : 31 .
entries.dua: Mudī - musangi pe ̱ mwena mwe nde jabea la tiki la Tet 'asu ńe o mo ̱ ń mu mongwane ̱ biso ̱ o be ̱ ne ̱ musango ma po ̱ ko ̱ po ̱ ko ̱ . - Bebolo 9 : 31 .

entries.en: We are awed by the knowledge that Jehovah , the greatest Person in the universe , manifests the appealing quality of humility .
entries.dua: Nika ńe biso ̱ mańaka o so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná Yehova , moto ńasam buka be ̱ se ̱ o misipo , a malee ̱ le ̱ ede ̱ mo a bwam ya sibise ̱ la ńolo .

entries.en: We are backed by Jehovah , Jesus , and the faithful angels .
entries.dua: Yehova na Yesu , na ange ̱ l a jemea ba masue ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We are convinced that Jehovah will not allow this wicked world to continue for even one day longer than his purpose requires . - Hab .
entries.dua: ( Mye . 37 : 10 , 11 ) Je mbaki ná pond 'a beńamsedi ba nin was 'a bobe e dongame ̱ n te ̱ , Yehova a si me ̱ nde ̱ jese ̱ le ̱ ná e bate wala oboso to ̱ buńa bō ̱ . - Hab .

entries.en: We are doing much better now as a couple . "
entries.dua: Tatan je bonam o diba lasu . "

entries.en: We are fully confident that he will give us all that he has promised . - Rom .
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n mbaki ni londi ná a me ̱ nde ̱ bola biso ̱ me ̱ se ̱ a kakane ̱ no ̱ . - Rom .

entries.en: We are grateful that we have come to know Jehovah and can enjoy the freedom that true worship brings .
entries.dua: Njika kie ̱ le ̱ ni maye ̱ ńa bwam ni menge ̱ le ̱ ba bena o nin we ̱ nge ̱ be o bolane ̱ na dibie ̱ wonja ba kusane ̱ no ̱ Loba e ?

entries.en: We are happy to say that our courageous lawyer accepted a Bible study and was attending meetings before he died .
entries.dua: Je muńe ̱ nge ̱ o kwala ná lo ̱ ya lasu le ngiń 'a mulema lemedi jokwa la Bibe ̱ l , di kumwa pe ̱ jukea o ndongame ̱ n oboso ná di mawo ̱ .

entries.en: We are keenly aware that the fault may lie in our imperfect view of matters .
entries.dua: Di bi bwambwam ná je ̱ ne ̱ lasu la mambo lena di titi ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ je ná di bola ná je ̱ ne ̱ ná diwuse ̱ di tombi .

entries.en: We are letting our light shine to an extent that could not have been imagined previously .
entries.dua: Je o jese ̱ le ̱ ná mwe ̱ ne ̱ n masu mu pańe o dime ̱ ne ̱ lena di si wusano ̱ to ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ bolane ̱ jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: We are merely keeping sovereignty and salvation in proper perspective .
entries.dua: Di mawe ̱ le ̱ nde man mato ̱ ti , janea na jongise ̱ , diwo ̱ te ̱ o epolo yangame ̱ n mo ̱ .

entries.en: We are moved by such love to endure in this work , recognizing that people may have a change of heart when their circumstances change .
entries.dua: ( Mat . 22 : 39 ) Ni ndolo nde e mongwane ̱ biso ̱ o be ̱ titimbe ̱ o y 'ebolo , di memba ná bato be ná ba tukwa milema mabu ke ̱ bete ̱ medi babu be tuko .

entries.en: We are no longer under the Law .
entries.dua: 7 : 9 ) Di titi pe ̱ owas 'a Mbenda .

entries.en: We are not afraid to do good works in Jehovah 's service just because the Devil might see us .
entries.dua: Di no ̱ nge yen eyembilan , di si mabwa bo ̱ ngo ̱ o bola mambo ma bwam o bolea lasu la Yehova buka te ̱ ońolana Diabolo a me ̱ ne ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We are not born with an inclination toward self - discipline .
entries.dua: Di si yabane ̱ bia la ńakisane ̱ ńolo , nde jangame ̱ n o jokwa bola nika .

entries.en: We are not born with such joy ; nor does it develop automatically .
entries.dua: Di si mayabane ̱ ni ńai a muńe ̱ nge ̱ ; mu si mapo ̱ pe ̱ to ̱ na mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We are not immune to these tactics .
entries.dua: E misomba , biso ̱ be ̱ se ̱ je ná di ko ̱ o malambi mao .

entries.en: We are not left in the dark .
entries.dua: Bibe ̱ l e mabola biso ̱ mwe ̱ ne ̱ n .

entries.en: We are not surprised when we have to endure harsh treatment from the world .
entries.dua: Nika e titi biso ̱ mańaka ke ̱ di matakisabe ̱ na ba bena ba si maboleye ̱ Yehova .

entries.en: We are now part of the Calgary Sign - Language Congregation , where I continue to serve as an elder .
entries.dua: Tatan je nde o mwemba ma eyem 'a bambuke ma Kalgary , owe ̱ ni neno ̱ mutudu .

entries.en: We are overwhelmed when we consider all that Jehovah has done in our behalf .
entries.dua: Di londi na muńe ̱ nge ̱ ke ̱ di me ̱ ne ̱ nje ye ̱ se ̱ Yehova a bolino ̱ ońol 'asu .

entries.en: We are part of a stable , secure , and everlasting organization .
entries.dua: Je muńe ̱ nge ̱ o be ̱ o bebokedi be bam , be mbo ̱ le ̱ , na be pe ̱ bwindea .

entries.en: We are proud of young Christians who are determined to resist pressure to share in sexual immorality , and Jehovah is proud of them too !
entries.dua: Di mabwane ̱ beso ̱ mbe ̱ be si be ̱ n bedangwedi ba mbamba muńe ̱ nge ̱ , Yehova pe ̱ mulemlem !

entries.en: We are sickened at heart when we learn of their horrible acts .
entries.dua: Di mabwa ndutu ke ̱ di sengi mambo ma njo ba mabolano ̱ .

entries.en: We are so thankful to Jehovah . " - Read Acts 10 : 34 , 35 .
entries.dua: Di matimbise ̱ le ̱ Yehova jita la masoma . " - Langa Bebolo 10 : 34 , 35 .

entries.en: We are still suffering the consequences of Adam 's terrible decision .
entries.dua: Di dia di mataka ońola mbupan ma bedomsedi ba bobe ba Adam .

entries.en: We are the only Witnesses they are exposed to .
entries.dua: Biso ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ nde je Mboṅ a Yehova ba bino ̱ .

entries.en: We are to beat our swords into plowshares .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 22 : 36 , 38 ) Di lule ̱ njomb 'asu mabao .

entries.en: We are to love our neighbor as ourselves .
entries.dua: Di to ̱ nde munasango asu ka biso ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We are told : " Yet , he [ Jehovah ] did not give him [ Abraham ] any inheritance in it , no , not even enough to put his foot on ; but he promised to give it to him as a possession and after him to his offspring , though as yet he had no child . "
entries.dua: E langwabe ̱ biso ̱ ná : " A [ Yehova ] si ta a bola mo ̱ [ Abraham ] sango oten to ̱ tanga diwo ̱ , nde a ta a kakane ̱ ná a mabola mo ̱ mo ̱ na mbot 'ao ni mawe ̱ mo ̱ ombusa , niponda ke ̱ a si yai to ̱ muna . "

entries.en: We are told to " continue to be made new in [ our ] dominant mental attitude . "
entries.dua: Bibe ̱ l e mome ̱ le ̱ ná " di [ benge ] timbisabe ̱ peńa na mudī o mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ [ masu ] . "

entries.en: We are truly grateful to know how to give honor Jehovah 's way .
entries.dua: A se ̱ masoma di matimbise ̱ le ̱ no ̱ o bia ne ̱ ni bola moto edube o mbadi ni do ̱ lisan Yehova !

entries.en: We are willing to wait for Jehovah because we know that he will fulfill his promise to give us everlasting life at exactly the right time , the best time !
entries.dua: Je ńai ni le ̱ le ̱ m o jenge ̱ le ̱ Yehova ońolana di bi ná a me ̱ nde ̱ londe ̱ dikaki lao la bola biso ̱ longe ̱ la bwindea o ponda ni te ̱ nge ̱ n na ńangame ̱ n !

entries.en: We arrived in Lisbon , Portugal , in August of 1964 .
entries.dua: Di po ̱ i o Lisbon , Potoki , o mo ̱ di má Dingindi 1964 .

entries.en: We asked what the letters meant , but no one seemed to know , or if they did , they would not tell us . " - Edith Brenisen .
entries.dua: Di baise ̱ nje yi litera i mapulano ̱ kwala , nde to ̱ moto a si ta a bia , nde to ̱ ba bia pe ̱ nde ba si wusa langwea biso ̱ . " - Edit Brenisen .

entries.en: We benefit from doing so , for God has our interests at heart .
entries.dua: 13 : 17 ) Di matombwane ̱ ke ̱ di boli nika , ebanja Loba a mapulea nde biso ̱ bwam .

entries.en: We build appreciation for discipline when we experience its benefits , which confirm God 's love for us .
entries.dua: Di mokwa nde to ̱ ndo ̱ mo ̱ ke ̱ je ̱ n muse ̱ ṅ mao ; owa nde di maso ̱ ṅtane ̱ no ̱ njika ndolo ninde ̱ ne ̱ Loba a be ̱ ne ̱ nno ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We came to the conclusion that even though I was to be left behind , it was right for Arthur to accept this privilege .
entries.dua: Di timbi domse ̱ ná to ̱ ná na wusano ̱ dia mbusa , e ta bwam ná Artur emeye y 'eto ̱ ti ende ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We can 't understand exactly how you feel , but Jehovah does and will keep raising you up .
entries.dua: Di titi ná di so ̱ ṅtane ̱ ná te ̱ ite ̱ i ne ̱ ni o masengano ̱ , nde Yehova mo ̱ a maso ̱ ṅtane ̱ wa , a me ̱ nde ̱ pe ̱ jembe ̱ wa .

entries.en: We can all have a share in the great teaching campaign that Jehovah is having done today .
entries.dua: Je ná di no ̱ ngo ̱ dongo o jokwa l 'Eyal 'a Loba Yehova a bokise ̱ no ̱ we ̱ nge ̱ o wase ńe ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: We can allow it to linger on our figurative palate so that we can recall the " delightful words " of truth and use them to help others . - Eccl .
entries.dua: Je ná di bola ná di we ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ o eyem 'asu ya mudī ná jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ " byala be kenji " ba mbale ̱ , na bolane ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ o jongwane ̱ bane ̱ . - Mul .

entries.en: We can also demonstrate our sincere forgiveness by praying for those who sin against us . - Luke 6 : 27 , 28 .
entries.dua: 6 : 14 , 15 ) Je pe ̱ ná di lee ̱ le ̱ ná di malakise ̱ na mbale ̱ ke ̱ di makane ̱ ońola ba ba wusane ̱ biso ̱ . - Lukas 6 : 27 , 28 .

entries.en: We can also find many Biblical examples of humans who maintained joy in the face of trying circumstances .
entries.dua: Je pe ̱ ná di so ̱ o Bibe ̱ l byembilan jita ba bato bena ba kombe ̱ muńe ̱ nge ̱ oteten a makekisan .

entries.en: We can also show our support of God 's sovereignty by our personal decisions .
entries.dua: Je pe ̱ ná di sue ̱ le ̱ byanedi ba Loba o bedomsedi di mano ̱ ngo ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: We can also think about what Paul accomplished as " a chosen vessel to [ Christ ] to bear [ Jesus ' ] name to the nations . "
entries.dua: Je pe ̱ ná di dutea o nje Paulo a bolino ̱ ka " ewa [ Kristo ] a po ̱ sino ̱ o walane ̱ dina la [ Yesu ] oboso ba matumba . "

entries.en: We can and should commend them for their hard work and strive to cooperate with directions that they provide .
entries.dua: Je ná di sesa babo ̱ , jangame ̱ n na bola nika ońol 'ebol 'abu ya ntū ; na we ̱ pe ̱ ná di sue ̱ le ̱ bediedi ba mabolano ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We can ask Jehovah for his holy spirit so that we can display its fruitage when speaking with our relatives .
entries.dua: ( Kol . 4 : 6 ) Je ná di baise ̱ Yehova mudī mao musangi ná di lee ̱ le ̱ epum 'ao ke ̱ di makwala na belongi basu ba mbia .

entries.en: We can ask ourselves , ' Do I avoid idolizing humans or using a great deal of valuable time on inconsequential matters ? ' - Read Ephesians 5 : 15 , 16 .
entries.dua: ( Bebolo 18 : 4 , 5 , 26 ) Je ná di baise ̱ na biso ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ ná , ' Mo ̱ na meka mbame ̱ ne ̱ na jowe ̱ la bato ba benama to ̱ bolane ̱ pond 'am ńa bwam ońola mambo m 'ewolo e ? ' - Langa Efeso 5 : 15 , 16 .

entries.en: We can ask ourselves : ' Do I offer hospitality primarily to close friends , prominent ones , or those who might be able to return a favor somehow ?
entries.dua: Je ná di baise ̱ biso ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ ná : ' Mo ̱ na mapomane ̱ nde kasa be ̱ n be mako ̱ m mam ma batabata , bato be mweńa , to ̱ so ̱ ba bena be ná ba timbise ̱ le ̱ mba bwam ná boledino ̱ babo ̱ o mbadi po ̱ to ̱ nine ̱ e ?

entries.en: We can be assured that " the generous person will be blessed . "
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ mbaki ná " mudo ̱ le ̱ mulema a me ̱ nde ̱ namsabe ̱ . "

entries.en: We can be sure that God , who " sees into the heart , " will make the truth grow in the hearts of rightly disposed ones . - 1 Sam .
entries.dua: ( 1 Tim . 2 : 3 , 4 ) Di boli te ̱ nika , di me ̱ nde ̱ we ̱ le ̱ jongwane ̱ bato bena , kana Petro , ba si be ̱ n je ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ la bwam o eboko , nde bena ba be ̱ n mulema ma bwam .

entries.en: We can be sure that he wants the best for us , as he did for his servants in the past . - Read Jeremiah 29 : 11 , 12 .
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ mbaki ná a mapulea biso ̱ bwam bo peti , ka nje a bolino ̱ ońola baboledi bao ba kwaṅ . - Langa Yeremia 29 : 11 , 12 .

entries.en: We can be sure that he will never disappoint those hoping in him . - Matt .
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ mbaki ná a si me ̱ nde ̱ caka ba bena ba lakisan mo ̱ tom . - Mat .

entries.en: We can be sure that Jehovah answers our prayers for help ( See paragraph 18 )
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ mbaki ná Yehova a malabe ̱ mika masu ná di kusane ̱ mo ̱ jongwane ̱ ( Ombwa dongo 18 )

entries.en: We can be sure that we can succeed with Jehovah 's help !
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ mbaki ná na jongwane ̱ la Yehova je ná di tongwe ̱ le ̱ !

entries.en: We can continue to cultivate our God - given abilities and expand in doing good works .
entries.dua: Je ná di benga ńaka o ngudi na o dibie ̱ Loba a bolino ̱ biso ̱ , di yamba pe ̱ o bebolo ba bwam .

entries.en: We can do so by doing things Jehovah 's way .
entries.dua: Je ná di bola nika tongwea na bola mambo o mbadi ni do ̱ lisan mo ̱ .

entries.en: We can do so successfully by applying the Bible 's wise advice .
entries.dua: Je ná di tongwe ̱ le ̱ o bola nika tongwea na we ̱ le ̱ o ebolo malea ma dibie ̱ ma Bibe ̱ l .

entries.en: We can do the same .
entries.dua: Biso ̱ pe ̱ je ná di bola mulemlem .

entries.en: We can easily see that we would never want to be like Nabal , unappreciative of good things done for us .
entries.dua: Di si be ̱ so ̱ ka Nabal nu si ta nu bia timbise ̱ le ̱ masoma ońola bwam ba boledino ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: We can enhance our love for Bible truth by regularly attending congregation meetings .
entries.dua: Je ná di bata ńakise ̱ ndol 'asu ńa Bibe ̱ l tongwea na jukea ponda te ̱ o ndongame ̱ n .

entries.en: We can enjoy similar blessings if we make spiritual progress our priority .
entries.dua: Je ná di bwane ̱ milemlem ma minam muńe ̱ nge ̱ ke ̱ di te ̱ se ̱ bońaki basu o mbad 'a mudī ka lambo laboso .

entries.en: We can find true inner peace by obeying Jehovah from the heart . - Isa .
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ ne ̱ musango ma teten ma mbale ̱ ke ̱ di sengane ̱ Yehova na mulema . - Yes .

entries.en: We can have unwavering confidence that Jehovah will act in our behalf .
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n mbaki ni bam ná Yehova a me ̱ nde ̱ jongwane ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We can imagine that they were thinking that Jesus would be an ideal leader . He was an outstanding speaker ; he could cure the sick ; he could even supply food for the hungry .
entries.dua: Ba ta mbaki ná Yesu a me ̱ nde ̱ nde be ̱ mudied 'a bwam : A ta a bia ekwali , a ta a be ̱ ne ̱ ngińa o bo ̱ lise ̱ baboedi ; na julise ̱ pe ̱ banjai .

entries.en: We can imagine their surprise and disappointment , though , when Peter suddenly stopped eating with them .

entries.dua: Di bati pe ̱ jokwa ná Janea lao di me ̱ nde ̱ bo ̱ le ̱ ndutu ye ̱ se ̱ na ná di be ̱ n dipita la be ̱ longe ̱ o bwindea o musango na o bonam owas 'a byanedi ba Janea . - Yohane 3 : 16 ; Bbī .

entries.en: We give proof that we truly love our brothers when we show by words and deeds that we have deep concern for " those related to us in the faith . " - Gal .
entries.dua: 4 : 11 ) Di mabola mboṅ ná di to ̱ ndi bonasango asu na mbale ̱ ke ̱ di lee ̱ le ̱ o byala na o bebolo ná di mombwea na mbale ̱ " bona basu bena be badubedi . " - Gal .

entries.en: We give to Jehovah because of our love and appreciation for him .
entries.dua: Di mabola nde Yehova mabea ońolana di to ̱ ndi mo ̱ di matimbise ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ mo ̱ masoma .

entries.en: We got married in 1957 .
entries.dua: Di bane ̱ o mbu ma 1957 .

entries.en: We got married nine months later - on January 30 , 1954 .
entries.dua: Di bane ̱ myo ̱ di dibua ombusa ponda , nik 'e ta nde 30 má Dimo ̱ di 1954 .

entries.en: We got married that same day .
entries.dua: Di bane ̱ bo buńa me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We graduated from the 27th class of Gilead School in July 1956 , and by November we were in our assignment - Brazil .
entries.dua: Di bo ̱ le ̱ esukulu a Gilead o mo ̱ di má Madibe ̱ dibe ̱ 1956 ka bautu ba klasi ni londe ̱ 27 , di lomabe ̱ o bolea o Brasil o mo ̱ di má Tinini .

entries.en: We had another frightening experience .
entries.dua: Di bo bo ̱ ngo ̱ bope ̱ pe ̱ .

entries.en: We had been cautioned to avoid living in a trailer because opposers might set it on fire , so we searched for a home , but in vain .
entries.dua: Di ta jomabe ̱ le ̱ ná di si ja o mutoa mu longedi ka bolongi ońolana bate ̱ nge ̱ ne ̱ biso ̱ ba wusa dise ̱ mo ̱ ; di wasi so ̱ bolongi , nde di si kusi .

entries.en: We had been in unassigned territory for some years , and now it was a wonderful blessing to be among so many brothers and sisters .
entries.dua: Di tombise ̱ ngus 'a mimbu wuma bate ̱ dikalo ba si tano ̱ , tatan njika bonam bonde ̱ ne ̱ o be ̱ oteten a bonasango na bonańango .

entries.en: We had begun setting up a business , but Father said to my brother , " If you want to go pioneering , we 'll get rid of this . "
entries.dua: Di botedi ńunga , nde Sango asu a langwea ndom 'am ná " O mapula te ̱ wala o bolea ka paonia , di m 'ese ̱ le ̱ nde man mambo me ̱ se ̱ . "

entries.en: We had dear friends in the white congregation .
entries.dua: Di ta di be ̱ ne ̱ mako ̱ m ma bwam o mwemba ma bakala .

entries.en: We had greatly enjoyed the traveling work , so at first I felt very apprehensive about the change .
entries.dua: Di ta di bwane ̱ ebol 'ebondo muńe ̱ nge ̱ , ońola nika , wala la Bete ̱ l di se ̱ le ̱ bwese ̱ mba bo ̱ ngo ̱ .

entries.en: We had high hopes because our district overseer wanted us to help a congregation down in Texas , and he wanted us to go there as specials .
entries.dua: Di ta di be ̱ ne ̱ jita la mapita ońolana muboled 'asu ńa bebondo a ta a pula ná jongwane ̱ mwemba ma Texas , ńo ̱ ng 'ao e ta nde ná jale owo ka paonia ya tobotobo .

entries.en: We had numerous Bible studies with young Kyrgyz students at educational institutes .
entries.dua: Di ta jokwa Bibe ̱ l na jita la beso ̱ mbe ̱ ba bome na ba bito ba Kirgis bena be ta bautu b 'esukulu .

entries.en: We had the special privilege of having Brother Frederick W .
entries.dua: Di ta di be ̱ ne ̱ edube ende ̱ ne ̱ o be ̱ ne ̱ na biso ̱ munasango Frederik W .

entries.en: We had to care for a family .
entries.dua: E ta e pula ná jombweye mbia masu .

entries.en: We had to determine quickly if we should try to give a short Scriptural presentation or just acknowledge our mistake and move on .
entries.dua: Di ta so ̱ jangame ̱ n dutea na pe ̱ le ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ nga je ná di keka bola o pe ̱ m jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ l 'epas 'a Bibe ̱ l to ̱ so ̱ jemba diwuse ̱ lasu nde jala .

entries.en: We had to make many trips to the post office to pick up the boxes of magazines and carry them to our accommodations .
entries.dua: Di ta be ̱ jala ngedi jita o post o no ̱ ngo ̱ kalati na wana mo ̱ mboa .

entries.en: We happily do these necessary things without any feeling of constraint or burden .
entries.dua: Je muńe ̱ nge ̱ o bola man mambo ma mapule ̱ biso ̱ esibe ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ ka mińakisan to ̱ mūna .

entries.en: We have a cavalry on our side .
entries.dua: Ebimb 'a ange ̱ l i maduane ̱ bebamban ye na biso ̱ .

entries.en: We have a further reason to continue our preaching work .
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n njo ̱ m nipe ̱ pe ̱ ńa walane ̱ ebol 'asu ya dikalo oboso .

entries.en: We have a wonderful relationship . "
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n mulatako ma bwam tatan . "

entries.en: We have also seen that we can learn from good examples of spiritual people .
entries.dua: Je ̱ n pe ̱ ná byembilan ba bato ba mudī be ná bokwe ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ .

entries.en: We have always been early risers , and that habit certainly helps at Bethel .
entries.dua: Di ta di ko ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ pomane ̱ wema , y 'ede ̱ mo yongwane ̱ biso ̱ o Bete ̱ l .

entries.en: We have at times made comments to that effect .
entries.dua: Di máto ̱ pea di to ̱ ti ngedi jita .

entries.en: We have been created in such a way that we find happiness in doing so .
entries.dua: Di wekabe ̱ ńai jeno ̱ bonam ke ̱ di mabola nika .

entries.en: We have been trained " to reject ungodliness and worldly desires and to live with soundness of mind and righteousness and godly devotion amid this present system of things . "
entries.dua: Jokwabe ̱ le ̱ ná " di to ̱ be dibangi la Loba na bepuledi ba nin wase , nde di dangwane ̱ ye ̱ ne ̱ , te ̱ me ̱ la sim na dube ̱ la Loba o nin wase . "

entries.en: We have considered a number of bad practices that Christians must strip off and keep off .
entries.dua: Jombwedi bede ̱ mo bō ̱ bena Kriste ̱ n ńangame ̱ nno ̱ o songwa na banga bo ̱ to ̱ pe ̱ te ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: We have considered what it means to be a spiritual person .
entries.dua: Jombwedi nje be ̱ la mot 'a mudī di mapulano ̱ o kwala .

entries.en: We have good reasons to include the resurrection as a key teaching even if we personally hope to survive the great tribulation and live on earth forever .
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n njo ̱ m ya bwam o we ̱ le ̱ bepumbwedi o muso ̱ ngi ma belēdi ba dibongo to ̱ ná di be ̱ nno ̱ dipita la jongisabe ̱ o ndenge ̱ ninde ̱ ne ̱ , na be ̱ pe ̱ longe ̱ o bwindea o wase .

entries.en: We have lived in this old world so long that we may have stopped noticing how much stress we feel over world conditions .
entries.dua: Di mája pond 'a bwaba o nin wase ńai di si me ̱ ne ̱ no ̱ pe ̱ nate ̱ na o njika dime ̱ ne ̱ e mabwese ̱ no ̱ biso ̱ ndutu .

entries.en: We have never regretted it . "
entries.dua: Di s 'ombwe ̱ to ̱ buńa . "

entries.en: We have no basis to expect that Jesus or his Father will now perform such a miracle for us .
entries.dua: Di si be ̱ n njo ̱ m to ̱ po ̱ o jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná Yesu to ̱ Sango ao ba me ̱ nde ̱ po ̱ ngo ̱ mulemlem ma betańsedi ońol 'asu nin we ̱ nge ̱ .

entries.en: We have not had any more problems . "
entries.dua: Di si wan pe ̱ bwambo to ̱ bō ̱ . "

entries.en: We have recently seen a number of significant adjustments in the field of theocratic education .
entries.dua: Di wu o je ̱ ne ̱ mawengisan mō ̱ ma mweńa o nje e mombweye ̱ besukulu ba Bibe ̱ l .

entries.en: We have seen from his past dealings that no matter what happens , Jehovah will always accomplish his purpose , and sometimes he does it in an unexpected manner .
entries.dua: Mabola mao matombi malee ̱ biso ̱ ná to ̱ e be ̱ nde ná nje , a malonde ̱ nde mwano mao ; dongo la ponda buka na nje di mengane ̱ no ̱ mo ̱ .

entries.en: We have seen that actual events in the past prove that a resurrection is possible - the dead can be brought back to life .
entries.dua: Joko ná bepumbwedi be tombi o mińa ma Bibe ̱ l be mabola mbaki ná bepumbwedi be me ̱ nde ̱ be ̱ - bawedi ba me ̱ nde ̱ timbisabe ̱ o longe ̱ .

entries.en: We have seen that we can promote Christian unity in three ways : ( 1 ) We put our trust in God 's heavenly Kingdom to correct injustice , ( 2 ) we refuse to take sides in political issues , and ( 3 ) we reject violence .
entries.dua: Joko ná je ná di sue ̱ le ̱ jalatane ̱ la Kriste ̱ n o mbadi ilalo : ( 1 ) Di lakisane ̱ ná Janea la mo ̱ ń la Loba di me ̱ nde ̱ bo ̱ le ̱ si te ̱ me ̱ la sim , ( 2 ) di si no ̱ ngo ̱ dongo o bekwali ba politik , na ( 3 ) di si bolane ̱ njo .

entries.en: We have to admit that we do not always know what the outcome of our choices will be ; nor do we know whether they will turn out for our good every time .
entries.dua: 2 : 9 ) Jangame ̱ n jemba ná di si bi ponda ye ̱ se ̱ nje mpo ̱ so ̱ ko masu mweno ̱ ná mu wana , di titi pe ̱ to ̱ mbaki ná mu me ̱ nde ̱ nde wanea biso ̱ tombwane ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ .

entries.en: We have to have a good relationship with him .
entries.dua: E mapula ná di be ̱ ne ̱ malatako ma bwam na mo ̱ .

entries.en: We have to learn it . To illustrate : When a child first learns to ride a bicycle , a parent usually holds the bicycle to steady it .
entries.dua: K 'eyembilan : Niponda muna eno ̱ o jokwa duane ̱ medi ma mundi , sango to ̱ ńango a malea medi ná okwe ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ ja ńai a bwam .

entries.en: We have to learn to adjust our unsteady steps to match Jehovah 's steady lead .
entries.dua: E mapula ná jokwe te ̱ se ̱ tanga lasu la lo ̱ ndo ̱ ná di dangwe kaponda bediedi ba Yehova be bam .

entries.en: We heard all of that from our room upstairs .
entries.dua: Di sengi nde man me ̱ se ̱ ke ̱ je o tuṅ asu omo ̱ ń a nde ̱ ki .

entries.en: We held hands , and I even prayed , " Jehovah , please , when they get us , may we die quickly ! "
entries.dua: Di kwe ̱ ne ̱ nde mā , nde na kane ̱ ná , " Son , a Yehova , yi mbo ̱ i kwedi te ̱ biso ̱ o ńolo , di pomane ̱ wo ̱ dibokime ̱ ne ̱ ! "

entries.en: We honor these brothers regardless of their nationality , education , social standing , or financial status .
entries.dua: Di mabola ban bonasango edube esibe ̱ wasa bia ekombo abu , bia labu la kalati , eyabe ̱ yabu to ̱ m 'bwaṅ mabu .

entries.en: We hope that our prayers will help a little . "
entries.dua: Di pite ̱ ná mika masu mi me ̱ nde ̱ jongwane ̱ wa son . "

entries.en: We hugged each other and agreed to put the matter behind us .
entries.dua: Di sokane ̱ bwanga , di sangilane ̱ bwambo .

entries.en: We interviewed several of these experienced sisters .
entries.dua: Di baise ̱ jita la ban bonańango boú myuedi .

entries.en: We invite you to visit the Bible museum and the other museums located at headquarters .
entries.dua: Di mabele ̱ wa o po ̱ pe ̱ pe ̱ le ̱ y 'epol 'ekotedi ya Bibe ̱ l na bepolo b 'ekotedi bepe ̱ pe ̱ be telame ̱ o mulopo m 'ebolo .

entries.en: We invited her in and gave her a glass of water .
entries.dua: Jinge ̱ le ̱ mo ̱ o ndabo , di bola mo ̱ to ̱ mbed 'a madiba .

entries.en: We knew that we would lose the case , but we realized that a great witness would result .
entries.dua: Di ta di bia ná di si me ̱ nde ̱ kusa mbako a bwam , nde nika e me ̱ nde ̱ jongwane ̱ ná mboṅ e bolabe ̱ .

entries.en: We know from our own experience how many blessings await those who decide to serve Jehovah .
entries.dua: Ońolana di bi njika minam mi menge ̱ le ̱ ba bena ba po ̱ si o bolea Yehova .

entries.en: We know from the Bible that there have been times when Jehovah did not directly intervene to protect his servants .
entries.dua: Di bi tongwea na Bibe ̱ l ná seto ̱ ponda ye ̱ se ̱ nde Yehova a sungino ̱ baboledi bao o ni mbadi .

entries.en: We know from the Scriptures that we are not living at a time when we can look to God for miraculous healings or an extension of our life .
entries.dua: Di bi tongwea na Betiledi ná di titi pe ̱ o ponda jeno ̱ ná jengane ̱ Loba ná a bo ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ o mbad 'a betańsedi , to ̱ ko ̱ ko ̱ mińa ma longe ̱ lasu .

entries.en: We know our enemy , his tactics , and his intentions .
entries.dua: 20 : 1 - 3 , 7 - 10 ) Di bi musinged 'asu , misomba mao , na mo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ mao .

entries.en: We know that he alone gives everlasting life . - Luke 12 : 4 , 5 .
entries.dua: Di bi ná mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ nde a mabole ̱ longe ̱ la bwindea . - Lukas 12 : 4 , 5 .

entries.en: We know that he can do whatever is needed to empower us to accomplish his will fully .
entries.dua: Di bi ná e ná a bola to ̱ nje e mapule ̱ o bola biso ̱ ngińa ńa londise ̱ jemea lao . ( 2 Kor .

entries.en: We know that it is possible only because Jehovah is backing the work . - Job 42 : 2 .
entries.dua: Di bi ná nika ńe nde ná e bolane ̱ buka te ̱ ońolana Yehova a masue ̱ le ̱ y 'ebolo . - Hiob 42 : 2 .

entries.en: We know that Jehovah cares for us and wants us to succeed .
entries.dua: Di bi ná Yehova a mombwea biso ̱ , a mapula pe ̱ ná di tongwe ̱ le ̱ .

entries.en: We know that we can trust you .
entries.dua: O mulopo ma nika , a kwalisane ̱ nde biso ̱ ná : " Di bi ba nja bińo ̱ leno ̱ , di mabola pe ̱ bedomsedi bańu edube .

entries.en: We lacked radio , television , and newspapers ; thus , we received news about the war only by word of mouth .
entries.dua: Di si ta di be ̱ ne ̱ radio , television , to ̱ ńuspepa ; ba ta nde ba langwea biso ̱ myango ma bila .

entries.en: We learn from our study of the Bible that Jehovah exercises authority in a loving manner .
entries.dua: Jokwa lasu la Bibe ̱ l di malee ̱ biso ̱ ná byanedi ba Yehova be se ̱ medi nde o ndolo .

entries.en: We learn the answers to those questions by considering the arrangement of cities of refuge in ancient Israel .
entries.dua: Jokwa la bete ̱ sedi ońola mindi ma diwutamea o Israel ńa kwaṅ di mala bola biso ̱ malabe ̱ ma min myuedi .

entries.en: We learn to put others first .
entries.dua: 1 : 5 ) Di mokwa pe ̱ o bola bane ̱ epol 'a boso .

entries.en: We learned that Jehovah is our Creator and Life - Giver and that he has a purpose for mankind .
entries.dua: Joko ná Yehova nde e Muweked 'asu na Mubole ̱ - Longe ̱ na ná a be ̱ n mwano ońola mbel 'a moto .

entries.en: We learned that the police were making daily raids on the homes of our brothers .
entries.dua: Joko ná polisi i ta i po ̱ o mamboa ma bonasango buńa te ̱ .

entries.en: We learned to do meaningful research and study .
entries.dua: Bokwe ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ ne ̱ ni jokwa na po ̱ ngo ̱ muwaso o njiba .

entries.en: We led a simple life in rural areas - doing without electricity , sleeping on mats , and traveling by horse and buggy .
entries.dua: Di ta nde di ja o eyidi , esibe ̱ mwaye ma kuraṅ , di nanga o bebumbu , jala pe ̱ lo ̱ ndo ̱ omo ̱ ń a wo ̱ si to ̱ so ̱ ebamban .

entries.en: We likewise help others " to search for Jehovah . "
entries.dua: Kana mo ̱ biso ̱ pe ̱ di mongwane ̱ bape ̱ pe ̱ " o pulise ̱ Yehova . "

entries.en: WE LIVE in a time of human history that is truly unique .
entries.dua: JE NDE o pond 'a tobotobo ńa myango ma mbel 'a moto .

entries.en: We live in a world full of wrongdoing .
entries.dua: Je nde o wase ni londi na beboledi ba bobe .

entries.en: We live in exciting times .
entries.dua: Nin pond 'asu ńe nde ńa betańsedi .

entries.en: We live together , study the Bible together , and work together .
entries.dua: Di maja nde mwemba , lokwa Bibe ̱ l mwemba , di bola pe ̱ ebolo mwemba .

entries.en: We lived in a tiny room on the second floor of a log cabin .
entries.dua: Di ta nde di ja o son a tuṅ a nde ̱ ki ni londe ̱ iba ńa ndabo a bebambu .

entries.en: We lived on a small farm in eastern South Dakota .
entries.dua: Di ta nde di ja o bolongi ba mōnda bosadi o jedu la Dakota ńa Mikondo .

entries.en: We long to see sickness and aging brought to an end .
entries.dua: Di be ̱ n ńo ̱ ngi ninde ̱ ne ̱ o je ̱ ne ̱ su la mitakisan mi mawe ̱ na bobe bwa Adam .

entries.en: We make it easier for them to avoid falling victim to pride , to having any feelings of superiority or self - righteousness .
entries.dua: Di mabola ná e be ̱ babo ̱ bo ̱ bise ̱ la ńolo o samba mudī ma lombitane ̱ , jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ la be ̱ mpete ̱ , to ̱ eyaye .

entries.en: We married in January 1949 with the goal of staying in full - time service as long as possible .
entries.dua: Di bane ̱ o mo ̱ di ma Dimo ̱ di o mbu má 1949 na nin ńo ̱ ngi ńa tika be ̱ o ebol 'a pond 'a mususu etum te ̱ epolo e me ̱ nde ̱ no ̱ je ̱ ne ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We may also find ourselves at greater risk if we are depressed and vulnerable .
entries.dua: Je pe ̱ ná di be ̱ o bete ̱ medi be nde ̱ nde ̱ le ̱ yete ̱ na di ńo ̱ sedi o mudī .

entries.en: We may also have been deeply influenced by our environment .
entries.dua: Mambo ma dinge ̱ le ̱ biso ̱ pe ̱ me ná ma be ̱ ne ̱ ngińa omo ̱ ń asu .

entries.en: We may be made aware of financial needs with regard to renovations to our local branch office , a convention we are attending , or assistance to our brothers after a natural disaster .
entries.dua: Ye ná e pula ná di bole jabea la mo ̱ ni o po ̱ ngulane ̱ mukanjo masu m 'ebolo , o sue ̱ le ̱ jako ̱ to ̱ ne ̱ dinde ̱ ne ̱ di mukeano ̱ , to ̱ jongwane ̱ bonasango asu bena mbeu a ńolo e kweledino ̱ .

entries.en: We may even become so desperate for emotional support that we will accept attention from just about anyone .
entries.dua: Ńo ̱ ng 'asu ńa mbidimbidi ma wea ńe ná e be ̱ bonde ̱ ne ̱ kańena jeno ̱ be ̱ be ̱ o jemea jongwane ̱ la to ̱ nja nde .

entries.en: We may feel that our small donations do not mean much .
entries.dua: Je ná jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ ná ngus 'asu ya mabea i titi to ̱ lambo .

entries.en: We may have given thought to what we already know about the subject , and we may even have done research in our publications .
entries.dua: Yen ebe di ta di mádutea jombwea nje di bino ̱ o di to ̱ ti , to ̱ ná di ta di mápo ̱ ngo ̱ muwaso o kalat 'asu .

entries.en: We may have some Bible knowledge and may regularly associate with the Christian congregation , but these things in themselves do not necessarily make us into a spiritual person .
entries.dua: Je ná di be ̱ ne ̱ so ̱ ṅtane ̱ diwo ̱ te ̱ nge ̱ la Bibe ̱ l , jukea pe ̱ o ndongame ̱ n na te ̱ pe ̱ dikalo , nde seto ̱ ma mambo nde ma mabole ̱ ye ̱ ke ̱ i te ̱ ná di be ̱ mot 'a mudī .

entries.en: We may have to work hard to develop the humility needed to show honor to others in this way .
entries.dua: ( Yohane 13 : 3 - 5 , 12 - 15 ) Ná di bole bape ̱ pe ̱ edube o nin mbadi , ye ná e baise ̱ ná di po ̱ nge miwe ̱ n minde ̱ ne ̱ o sa sibise ̱ la ńolo .

entries.en: We may readily acknowledge this fact , but the challenge is when we are personally affected by the imperfections of a brother .
entries.dua: 3 : 2 ) Je ná di pomane ̱ jemea ni mbale ̱ , nde nje ye ndutu ye nde ke ̱ si be ̱ la ke ̱ nge ̱ nge ̱ la bonasango asu di tapi biso ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ .

entries.en: We may simply have to live with the consequences .
entries.dua: Je nde eto ̱ m o lembe ̱ betune bao . ( Gal .

entries.en: We may think of a child who gives a gift to his parents from the small allowance they have given him .
entries.dua: Di duteye te ̱ jombwea muna nu mabolane ̱ mo ̱ ni bayedi bao ba mabolano ̱ mo ̱ o jandea babo ̱ jabea .

entries.en: We may think of him as loving and usually measured in his speech and actions .
entries.dua: We ná we ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ ka mō ̱ nu ta muyao na ńena nu ta nu bia me ̱ ne ̱ byala bao oboso ná a mato ̱ po ̱ to ̱ bola lambo .

entries.en: We may well stay far away from practices that God hates .
entries.dua: Je ná di panda etum na mambo Loba a singe ̱ no ̱ .

entries.en: We may wonder if James and John would have reacted the same way if the inhospitable village had been in their home region of Galilee .
entries.dua: ( Lukas 9 : 51 - 56 ) Yen ebe Yakobo na Yohane ba si wusa linga mulemlem e be ̱ te ̱ ná nika e bolane ̱ nde o mundi mabu ma Galilea .

entries.en: We might ( 1 ) unwittingly rely on human wisdom , ( 2 ) turn to bad associations , ( 3 ) become haughty , or ( 4 ) make decisions without first considering what God 's will is .

entries.dua: Seto ̱ ońolana mom 'ango ̱ to ̱ munj 'ango ̱ a titi o bolea Loba o dibokime ̱ ne ̱ nde wangame ̱ nno ̱ o jabane ̱ to ̱ bwa diba .

entries.en: Your new field service group overseer should endeavor to share with you in the ministry soon after your arrival .
entries.dua: Mombwed 'a dibo ̱ to ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ la dikalo ńa peńa a me ̱ nde ̱ to ̱ ndo ̱ te ̱ dikalo na wa ombusa po ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ .

entries.en: Your reading of the Word of God may move you to take action that will increase your happiness and strengthen your friendship with God as well as spur you on to help others to search for God .
entries.dua: Bolanga bo ̱ ngo ̱ ba Eyal 'a Loba bwe ná bo tute ̱ le ̱ wa o bebolo be mabateye ̱ wa mutam na joúse ̱ pe ̱ diko ̱ m lo ̱ ngo ̱ na Loba ; bo mabola pe ̱ wa ngińa o jongwane ̱ bape ̱ pe ̱ ná ba pulise ̱ Loba .

entries.en: Your singing voice will become fuller , and that is a good thing .
entries.dua: 24 : 14 ) Doi lo ̱ ngo ̱ di mabata be ̱ ngińa , nika ńe lambo la bwam .

entries.en: Your Son 's sacrifice is not enough to cover me . '
entries.dua: Jabea la diko ̱ ti la mun 'ango ̱ di si dongame ̱ n o kudumane ̱ myobe mam . '

entries.en: Your willingness to forgive may well reflect Jehovah 's view of justice . - Read Matthew 6 : 14 , 15 .
entries.dua: Be ̱ lo ̱ ngo ̱ la ńai ni le ̱ le ̱ m o lakise ̱ di malee ̱ ná o membilane ̱ te ̱ me ̱ la sim la Yehova . - Langa Mateo 6 : 14 , 15 .

entries.en: Your words were found , and I ate them ; and your word became to me the exultation and the rejoicing of my heart , for your name has been called on me , O Jehovah God of armies .
entries.dua: " Byala bo ̱ ngo ̱ be kwedino ̱ mba o matoi , na dedi nde mo ̱ ; eyal 'ango ̱ e ta nde muńe ̱ nge ̱ na mutam ma mulema mam , ońolana na belabe ̱ dina lo ̱ ngo ̱ , a Yehova Loba la mamuti . " ( Yer .

entries.en: Youths , you can make it easier for yourselves if you have a good idea where you want to go in life .
entries.dua: A beso ̱ mbe ̱ , bińo ̱ le ná lo no ̱ ngo ̱ bedomsedi ba bwam yete ̱ na lo bi njika ngea bińo ̱ langame ̱ nno ̱ no ̱ ngea o longe ̱ .

entries.en: Youths do this by reaching out for spiritual goals and by giving the preaching work high priority .
entries.dua: Ba mate ̱ se ̱ mambo ma mudī o bupe ̱ , na bola pe ̱ ebol 'a dikalo epol 'a mweńa o longe ̱ labu .

entries.en: Youths in the Christian congregation are precious in the eyes of Jehovah , who loves them dearly and gives them his protection , guidance , and blessing .
entries.dua: ( Min . 3 : 5 , 6 ) Beso ̱ mbe ̱ be o mwemba ma Kriste ̱ n be tiki o miso ̱ ma Yehova , a to ̱ ndi babo ̱ jita , a matata , die ̱ le ̱ , na namse ̱ pe ̱ babo ̱ .

entries.en: Zacchaeus , the chief tax collector in Jericho , had become rich by extorting money from the people .
entries.dua: Sakeo , mwaned 'a bako ̱ tedi o Yeriko , a timbi be ̱ m 'bwaṅ ońolana a ta be ̱ a no ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ bato mo ̱ ni na mińakisan .

entries.en: Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector who had become rich by extorting money .
entries.dua: Sakeo a ta nde mwaned 'a bako ̱ tedi nu timbi ko ̱ m 'bwaṅ ońola ndumban .

entries.en: Zeal , if properly directed , can transform sincere individuals into zealous disciples of Christ , as Paul well knew .
entries.dua: Ko ̱ di ni lati na so ̱ ṅtane ̱ di bake ̱ ńe ná e tukwa bato ba mbale ̱ , e timbise ̱ babo ̱ bokwedi ba Kristo ba ko ̱ di , mulemlem kana Paulo .

entries.en: Zeal for the ministry increased .
entries.dua: Ko ̱ di ońola dikalo e bati ńaka .

entries.en: Zealously apply the things you learn
entries.dua: Be ̱ ko ̱ di o we ̱ le ̱ o ebolo nje o mokwano ̱

entries.en: Zechariah 's next vision guarantees this bright hope .
entries.dua: Je ̱ ne ̱ di bupe ̱ la Sakaria di mabamse ̱ din dipita la mbaki .

entries.en: Zechariah 's next words remove any remaining fear or doubt .
entries.dua: Byala ba Sakaria be mabupe ̱ be sumwane ̱ babo ̱ bo ̱ ngo ̱ na penda .

entries.en: Zechariah 's sixth and seventh visions are a sober warning to those who persist in dishonest ways , a reminder that Jehovah does not tolerate wrongdoing . On the part of his sincere worshippers , there must be a genuine hatred of wickedness .
entries.dua: Me ̱ ne ̱ ma londe ̱ mutoba na samba Sakaria e ̱ nno ̱ me nde mome ̱ le ̱ ma ngińa ońola ba bena ba tingame ̱ o bola bobe , o jo ̱ nge ̱ le ̱ babo ̱ ná Yehova a si makasa beboledi ba bobe .

entries.en: Zechariah 's sixth vision has helped us to see that lovers of Jehovah should not engage in any kind of stealing or make false oaths .
entries.dua: Je ̱ ne ̱ di londe ̱ mutoba la Sakaria jongwane ̱ biso ̱ o je ̱ ne ̱ ná bato ̱ nde ̱ Yehova ba pandise ̱ babo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ na pat 'a jiba ye ̱ se ̱ na makakane ̱ ma mpoṅ .

entries.en: Zechariah and his fellow Jews could confirm that Babylon was a place of wickedness in their day .
entries.dua: Sakaria na bane ̱ Bonayuda ba ta ba bia ná Babilon e ta nde ekombo a bobe , ya musonje , na ya jowe ̱ la losango .

entries.en: Zechariah has had eight visions that he alone observed .
entries.dua: Sakaria a kusi me ̱ ne ̱ lo ̱ mbi mena mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ mō ̱ e ̱ nno ̱ .

entries.en: Zechariah is told to collect silver and gold from Heldai , Tobijah , and Jedaiah - three new arrivals returning from Babylon - and to make " a grand crown " out of the contributions .
entries.dua: Loba a ta anea Sakaria ná a kasane ̱ Heldai , Tobiya na Yedaya - bato balalo ba wu peńa o Babilon - mabea ma silba na gol , ná a po ̱ ngo ̱ ne ̱ mo ̱ " ekoto " ende ̱ ne ̱ . ( Sak .

entries.en: Zechariah knew that the Jews who moved to Jerusalem were men and women of faith .
entries.dua: Sakaria a ta a bia ná Bonayuda ba timbi o Yerusalem ba ta nde bome na bito ba dube ̱ .

entries.en: Zechariah sees flying through the air a scroll nearly 30 feet ( 9 m ) long and 15 feet ( 4.5 m ) wide !
entries.dua: Sakaria e ̱ n m 'bo ̱ m ma kalati mu mapumwa o ngo ̱ mwe bwaba ba lambo ka 30 ma mabo ̱ ngo ̱ ( 9 m ) na tindame ̱ la lambo ka 15 la mabo ̱ ngo ̱ na matanu ( 4.5 m ) !

entries.en: Zedekiah swore by Jehovah that he would remain a loyal vassal to the king of Babylon . However , Zedekiah did not keep his sworn oath .
entries.dua: Sedekia a ta a ńo ̱ male o dina la Yehova ná a me ̱ nde ̱ sibise ̱ mo ̱ me ̱ ne ̱ owas 'a kiṅ 'a Babilon .

entries.en: Şirin , a sister from Germany , wrote : " The brothers in Turkey witness informally with great ease .
entries.dua: Şirin nu wu o Jaman a tili ná : " Bonasango ba To ̱ rki be iwiye ̱ o dikalo la m 'bengu .
